# RaggieScript v1.3.0 — Complete Technical Reference (llms-full.txt)

> Complete language, gradual type system, defer/optional-chaining/test runner, 31-namespace Standard Library (incl. StoreScript for StoreTrainer, Story Crossroads, 23-method archive.*, & Reg-Free COM), Declarative Win32 Wizard UI, Two-Way .NET Host SDK, RSWBC2 bytecode, and RSW700-RSW715 reference.

================================================================================
TOPIC: Welcome & 60-Second Quick Start [welcome] (Getting Started)
================================================================================

# Welcome to RaggieScript v1.3 (`.rssc`) {#welcome}

**RaggieScript (`v1.3.0`, `.rssc`)** is RaggieSoft's open-source (**MIT License**), gradually typed, capability-sandboxed curly-brace scripting language, declarative Win32 Wizard UI engine, **StoreScript** trainer DSL, **Story Crossroads** branching narrative engine, and multi-target SDK powering all eight **RaggieSoft Studio** developer tools, consumer desktop apps, and standalone zero-dependency Windows `x64` and `ARM64` micro-applications.

> [!TIP] Press `Ctrl+K` (or `/`) anywhere on **raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev** to search every namespace, function signature, property, and `RSW700`–`RSW715` diagnostic instantaneously, or browse the [Master A–Z API Index](api-index.html).

## Why RaggieScript Exists {#why-raggiescript}

Traditional setup scripting systems force an unpleasant choice between cryptic relational database custom actions, fragile batch/PowerShell wrappers that break on locked corporate machines, or proprietary Domain-Specific Languages lacking modern types, closures, formatters, and Language Servers.

RaggieScript solves those pain points from first principles:

1. **Familiar Curly-Brace Syntax with Gradual Static Types**: Write clean `let` / `const` code with automatic type inference, or annotate `struct`, `enum`, `fn`, `path`, and `version` (`v"10.0.22000"`) types checked in under `1 ms` (`RSW710`–`RSW715`).
2. **Compile-Time Wizard Phase Isolation (`RSW701`) & Commit-Time Deferred UAC**: The compiler statically proves `wizard { ... }` cannot mutate files, Registry keys, or services—allowing `uac: Uac.Deferred` setups to run their entire interactive wizard un-elevated (`asInvoker`) and request UAC elevation only at commit time when the user clicks **Install**.
3. **Compile-Time Capability Sandboxing (`RSW702`)**: A script declaring `use training;` or `use a11y;` is mathematically prevented at compile time from calling `fs.*`, `reg.*`, `proc.*`, `msi.*`, `ffi.*`, or `net.*`.
4. **Automatic LIFO Transactional Rollback (`.rsw-rollback.jnl`)**: Every mutating call inside `install { ... }` backs up overwritten files to `.rswbak` and journals previous Registry/service/shortcut states before mutating, rewinding automatically if an error or user cancellation occurs.
5. **Three Verified Execution Targets from One Grammar**:
   - **Native Static `/MT` Win32 C++20 Stack VM (`RSWBC2`)** (`x64` & `ARM64`, zero external DLLs)
   - **Managed `.NET` SDK (`RaggieScript.Core`)** for Accessibility, Localization, Document, and Launcher Studio
   - **CSP-Safe `ES2022` JavaScript Module Transpiler** (`transpile-es2022`) for SCORM 1.2 & 2004 courses in Training Studio

## 60-Second Quick Start {#quick-start}

Create `hello-setup.rssc` and verify, compile, or pack it into a standalone Windows `.exe`:

```rssc
use installer;

package "Sainte-Claire Patch Librarian" {
    id:        "RaggieSoft.SainteClaireLibrarian";
    version:   v"1.4.0";
    publisher: "RaggieSoft";
    scope:     Scope.Machine;
    uac:       Uac.Deferred;
    style:     WizardStyle.FluentMica;
}

param installDir: path = sys.programFiles / "RaggieSoft" / "Patch Librarian";
param acceptEula: bool = false;

wizard {
    step Welcome {
        ui.welcome(
            title:    "Welcome to ${product.name}",
            subtitle: "Detected Silicon: ${sys.arch()} (Windows Build ${sys.osBuild()})",
            body:     "This setup installs ${product.name} v${product.version}."
        );
    }
    step License {
        ui.license(
            text:       "MIT License — Copyright (c) 2026 RaggieSoft.",
            acceptText: "I &accept the license terms",
            bind:       ref acceptEula
        );
    }
    step Destination {
        ui.folderPicker(label: "&Destination folder:", bind: ref installDir, minFreeMB: 50);
    }
    step Ready {
        ui.readySummary(heading: "Ready to Install ${product.name}", showUacShield: !sys.isAdmin());
    }
}

install {
    ui.progress(30, "Creating installation directory...");
    fs.mkdir(installDir);
    fs.writeJson(installDir / "install-receipt.json", {
        product: product.name,
        version: product.version,
        arch:    sys.arch()
    });
    reg.writeString(Hive.HKLM, r"Software\RaggieSoft\PatchLibrarian", "InstallDir", str(installDir));
    ui.progress(100, "Installation complete.");
}
```

Run the standalone CLI (`raggiescript.exe`):

```powershell
# 1. Type-check RSW701 Phase Isolation, RSW702 Sandbox & RSW710-RSW715 Types in <1 ms
raggiescript.exe check hello-setup.rssc

# 2. Format source while preserving 100% of // teaching comments
raggiescript.exe fmt --write hello-setup.rssc

# 3. Pack into a single zero-dependency native Windows .exe
raggiescript.exe pack-exe hello-setup.rssc PatchLibrarianSetup.exe
```

## RaggieSoft Reference Portal — Dogfooded with Help Studio {#dogfooded-help-studio}

**raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev** is an official **RaggieSoft Reference Portal**—our three-column, zero-database technical documentation and API specification format authored as a plain-text `.rshp` manifest + Markdown topic tree and compiled directly by **RaggieSoft Help Studio (`rshbuild.exe` v0.6.0)**. A single build emits this searchable Reference Portal (with live TOC filtering, `Ctrl+K` symbol search, and *"In this article"* navigation), our offline Windows `F1` viewer (`RaggieScriptHelp.exe`), `module.rshm.json`, `F1` Context-ID SDK headers, `llms-full.txt`, and an HTML5 VPAT 2.5 report from one source of truth.

## Standard Library Map (31 Namespaces) {#namespace-map}

| Namespace | Capability Profile | Primary Role | Reference |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [Global Built-Ins & Constants](builtins-and-constants.html) | Always Available | `str()`, `int()`, `path()`, `ver()`, `len()`, `assert()`, `def()`, `Scope`, `Uac`, `Hive`, `RegView`, `CertStore` | [View Globals](builtins-and-constants.html) |
| [`Validation.*` & `compile.*`](builtins-and-constants.html#validation-namespace) | Always / Build-Time | Field validation closures (`Validation.ok/error`) and bytecode-embedded JSON/text (`compile.json`) | [View Helpers](builtins-and-constants.html#validation-namespace) |
| [`payload.*` & `feature.*`](builtins-and-constants.html#feature-namespace) | `use installer;` | Feature selection states (`isSelected`, `selectPreset`) and staged payload paths | [View Features](builtins-and-constants.html#feature-namespace) |
| [`sys.*`](ns-sys.html) | Always (Read) / `installer` (Reboot) | True `ARM64`/`x64` silicon (`IsWow64Process2`), un-shimmed `RtlGetVersion`, UAC, DPI, known folders | [View `sys.*`](ns-sys.html) |
| [`str.*`, `regex.*`, `array.*`, `map.*`, `time.*`, `math.*`, `json.*`, `ini.*`, `xml.*`](ns-data-and-text.html) | Always (`ini`/`xml` writes require `installer`) | Strings, regex, `array` (`reduce`/`sort`/`unique`), `map.*`, `time.*` (`ISO8601`/SCORM), `math.*`, JSON, `.ini`, & XML | [View Data/Math/Time](ns-data-and-text.html) |
| [`fs.*` & `reg.*`](ns-fs-and-reg.html) | `use installer;` / `showcase` | Rollback-journaled filesystem, `RSWPAK1` extraction, Authenticode check, & stateless 64/32-bit Registry | [View `fs` & `reg`](ns-fs-and-reg.html) |
| [`archive.*`, `crypto.*`, `net.*`, `log.*`](ns-archive-crypto-net-log.html) | `crypto`/`log` Always; `archive`/`net` Host | 23-method `archive.*` (`.7z`, `.zip`, `.rswpak`, `.iso`, `.wim`), `bcrypt.dll` SHA-256, `WinHTTP` + `net.isPortFree` | [View Archive/Net](ns-archive-crypto-net-log.html) |
| [`proc.*`, `ffi.*`, `rm.*`, `com.*`, `font.*`, `sign.*`, `cert.*`, `mutex.*`, `activesetup.*`, `shortcut.*`, `shell.*`, `env.*`, `arp.*`, `svc.*`, `task.*`, `firewall.*`, `acl.*`](ns-proc-ffi-rm-system.html) | `use installer;` | Reg-Free COM `.manifest`s, zero-reboot fonts, X.509/Authenticode inspection, mutexes, Active Setup, Services, & ACLs | [View System & COM](ns-proc-ffi-rm-system.html) |
| [`msi.*` & `prereq.*`](ns-msi-and-prereq.html) | `use installer;` | Direct 64-bit MSI relational SQL DDL/DML, `.mst` transforms, `MsiSetExternalUIRecord`, `.NET` 8–11 presets | [View `msi.*`](ns-msi-and-prereq.html) |
| [`ui.*`, `wizard.*`, `showcase.*`](ns-ui-and-wizard.html) | `use ui;` / `installer` / `showcase` | 14 declarative in-window Win32 controls, `TaskDialogIndirect`, 11 themes, & 12 Showcase canvas/UIA methods | [View `ui.*`](ns-ui-and-wizard.html) |
| [`training.*`, `a11y.*`, `localization.*`, `document.*`, `launcher.*`, `help.*`](studio-sandbox-profiles.html) | Sandboxed Studio Profiles | SCORM 1.2/2004 state, Guided Fix diffs & WebVTT cues, locked token/RTL checks, PDF/UA-1 tables, & `F1` routing | [View Studio APIs](studio-sandbox-profiles.html) |
| [`storescript.*` & `crossroads.*`](storescript-and-crossroads.html) | Sandboxed Consumer Profiles | **StoreScript** binary/JSON save-file trainer DSL (*StoreTrainer*) & **Story Crossroads** interactive branching novels | [View StoreScript & Crossroads](storescript-and-crossroads.html) |

# CLI (`raggiescript.exe`), LSP, VS Code & Multi-Target SDKs {#cli-and-sdk}

`raggiescript.exe` is a single zero-dependency static `/MT` Win32 C++20 executable compiled natively for both **Windows 11 `ARM64`** and **Windows 11 `x64`**. It serves simultaneously as the compiler, type checker, formatter, JSON-RPC 2.0 Language Server, ES2022 transpiler, bytecode disassembler, runtime VM, and single-file `.exe` micro-app packager.

## Command-Line Interface Reference (`raggiescript.exe`) {#cli-commands}

| Subcommand | Syntax | Exit Codes | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `check` | `raggiescript.exe check [--diagnostics=json] <file.rssc> [-DKEY=VAL]` | `0` = Clean, `1` = Diagnostics, `2` = Bad CLI | Runs preprocessing, parsing, `RSW701` phase isolation, `RSW702` capability sandboxing, and `RSW710`–`RSW715` gradual type checking without executing code. |
| `compile` | `raggiescript.exe compile <in.rssc> <out.rswbc> [-DKEY=VAL]` | `0` = Emitted, `1` = Error | Compiles `.rssc` source into a compact, `SHA-256`-authenticated `RSWBC2` linear stack bytecode binary. |
| `disasm` | `raggiescript.exe disasm <in.rssc \| in.rswbc \| packed.exe>` | `0` = Printed, `1` = Tampered/Invalid | Disassembles `.rssc` source, `.rswbc` bytecode, or an embedded `#225` resource inside a packed `.exe` into human-readable constant pools and stack opcodes. |
| `run` | `raggiescript.exe run <in.rssc \| in.rswbc> [--silent] [/l=log.txt] [KEY=VAL] [KEY:VAL]` | Script exit code (`0`, `3010`, `1602`, `1603`, etc.) | Executes the full `wizard` -> `install` (or top-level micro-app) lifecycle with automatic `.rsw-rollback.jnl` protection. |
| `test` | `raggiescript.exe test [--json] <file.rssc \| directory>` | `0` = All passed, `1` = Failure | Discovers and executes top-level `test "<Name>" { ... }` unit-test blocks across a `.rssc` file or directory tree, reporting per-test millisecond timings in human or CI JSON format! |
| `fmt` | `raggiescript.exe fmt [--write \| --check] <file.rssc>` | `0` = Formatted/Clean, `1` = Needs formatting | Canonicalizes 4-space indentation, brace spacing, and operator alignment while preserving **100%** of `//` and `/* */` comments (`fmt(fmt(x)) == fmt(x)`). |
| `lsp` | `raggiescript.exe lsp` | `0` on `shutdown`/`exit` | Starts the JSON-RPC 2.0 Language Server over `stdin`/`stdout` (`Content-Length` framed) for VS Code and LSP-compatible IDEs. |
| `transpile-es2022` | `raggiescript.exe transpile-es2022 <in.rssc> <out.mjs>` | `0` = Emitted, `1` = Capability/Type error | Compiles a sandboxed `use training;` script into a pure, zero-`eval()` ES2022 JavaScript module for SCORM 1.2 & 2004 web players. |
| `pack-exe` | `raggiescript.exe pack-exe <in.rssc> <out.exe> [--support-dir=DIR] [--uac=LEVEL] [--icon=ICO]` | `0` = Packed, `1` = Error | Clones the native `raggiescript.exe` host, embeds `LZMS`-compressed `RSWBC2` bytecode (`#225`) + `RSWPAK1` payloads (`#220`), and stamps PE `VERSIONINFO`, `.ico`, and UAC manifest. |
| `init` | `raggiescript.exe init [installer \| showcase \| training \| a11y \| app] [out.rssc]` | `0` = Created | Generates a heavily commented starter `.rssc` template for the chosen Studio profile. |

## Soft Override (`KEY=VAL`) vs. IT Policy Hard-Lock (`KEY:VAL`) {#cli-property-locks}

Every `param` declared in a RaggieScript setup is automatically bindable from the command line without writing manual `argv` parsers:

```powershell
# Soft Override ('='): sets initial default, but wizard UI or script logic may adjust it
Setup.exe /s installDir="D:\Apps\Workbench" createDesktopLink=false

# Hard IT Policy Lock (':'): locks the parameter immutably!
# Wizard controls bound to 'installDir' are disabled, and script reassignment fails with RSW713!
Setup.exe /s installDir:"C:\Program Files\LockedByEnterpriseIT\Workbench"
```

> [!IMPORTANT] Hard-locked `KEY:VALUE` properties are enforced by the VM runtime even if a script attempts to overwrite the variable later (`RSW713`), giving enterprise GPO deployments ironclad path and telemetry guarantees.

## JSON Diagnostics Mode (`--diagnostics=json`) {#json-diagnostics}

CI pipelines, `InstallerStudio.exe`, and AI coding agents can pass `--diagnostics=json` to receive deterministic structured output:

```powershell
raggiescript.exe check --diagnostics=json setup.rssc
```

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "file": "setup.rssc",
  "diagnostics": [
    {
      "severity": "error",
      "code": "RSW701",
      "line": 18,
      "column": 9,
      "endColumn": 23,
      "message": "Phase isolation violation: mutating call 'reg.writeString()' is forbidden inside 'wizard { ... }'."
    }
  ]
}
```

## JSON-RPC 2.0 Language Server (`raggiescript.exe lsp`) {#lsp-server}

The built-in LSP server implements the standard Language Server Protocol over `stdio` with zero Node.js runtime dependencies inside the server binary:

- `initialize` / `shutdown` / `exit`
- `textDocument/didOpen`, `textDocument/didChange`, `textDocument/didSave` -> live `textDocument/publishDiagnostics` (`RSW700`–`RSW715`)
- `textDocument/completion` -> context-aware dot-member IntelliSense across all 21 namespaces (`fs.`, `msi.`, `ui.`, `sys.`, user `struct` fields, and `enum` variants)
- `textDocument/hover` -> Markdown signature cards, parameter counts, return types, and `[Mutating]` / `[Read-Only]` safety annotations
- `textDocument/definition` -> jump-to-definition for user `fn`, `struct`, `enum`, and `param` symbols
- `textDocument/formatting` -> comment-preserving whole-document formatting

## Embedding the C++20 & `.NET` SDKs {#embedding-sdks}

### Native Static `/MT` C++20 Umbrella Header (`RaggieScriptSdk.hpp`) {#cpp-sdk}

```cpp
#include <raggiescript/RaggieScriptSdk.hpp>

rsw::rssc::ScriptProgram prog;
std::vector<rsw::rssc::ScriptDiagnostic> diags;
if (rsw::rssc::CompileRaggieScriptFile(L"setup.rssc", prog, diags)) {
    rsw::rssc::VmExecutionOptions opts{};
    opts.silentMode = true;
    rsw::rssc::RaggieScriptVm vm(prog, opts);
    const auto result = vm.ExecuteFullLifecycle();
}
```

### Two-Way Managed `.NET` Host SDK (`RaggieScript.Core` v1.3) {#dotnet-sdk}

`RaggieSoft.RaggieScript.Core` (`Y:\desktop-apps\raggiescript\dotnet\src\RaggieScript.Core\`) is a **zero-dependency managed C# compiler, static type/capability binder (`RSW700`–`RSW715`), two-way `.NET` runtime, StoreScript & Story Crossroads host engine, and `ES2022` transpiler** built for .NET desktop, CLI, and server applications (powering Accessibility Studio, Training Studio, Localization Studio, Document Studio, Launcher, Book Reader, and StoreTrainer).

#### 1. Two-Way Host Interop Surface (`RsscHostEnvironment` & `RsscManagedRuntime`) {#dotnet-host-api}

| `.NET` Type / Member | Direction | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `RsscHostEnvironment.RegisterFunction(ns, name, Delegate, isMutating?, requiredCapability?)` | `.NET` -> `.rssc` | Exposes any synchronous (`Func<...>`, `Action<...>`) or asynchronous (`Func<..., Task<T>>`, `ValueTask<T>`) C# delegate under `ns.name(...)`, automatically injecting `CancellationToken` parameters and enforcing `RSW701` (`isMutating`), `RSW702` (`requiredCapability`), and `RSW712` (arity) at compile time! |
| `RsscHostEnvironment.RegisterGlobalFunction(name, Delegate, isMutating?)` | `.NET` -> `.rssc` | Exposes a top-level C# delegate callable directly without a namespace prefix (`toSlug("...")`). |
| `RsscHostEnvironment.RegisterService(instance, namespaceOverride?, requiredCapability?)` | `.NET` -> `.rssc` | Reflects an allowlisted C# service decorated with `[RsscHostObject("ns")]` and binds both `camelCase` and `PascalCase` methods while **never** exposing `System.Object.GetType()`. |
| `RsscHostEnvironment.ExposeObject(name, instance, readOnly = true)` | Two-Way | Exposes an allowlisted C# POCO, `record`, or scalar as a global variable in `.rssc`. Setting `readOnly: false` allows scripts to mutate properties (`profile.title = "..."`) and invoke instance methods (`profile.addTag("...")`) directly on the live `.NET` object! |
| `[RsscHostObject(ns, RequiredCapability)]`, `[RsscFunction(name, Mutating)]`, `[RsscIgnore]` | Metadata | Declarative C# attributes controlling namespace naming, `RSW701` wizard-mutation blocking, and property/method hiding (`[RsscIgnore]`). |
| `RsscManagedRuntime.Invoke<T>(fnName, params args)` | `.rssc` -> `.NET` | Calls a RaggieScript `fn` synchronously, marshaling C# POCOs/records in and hydrating the returned RaggieScript `struct`/`map` into `T` (including C# `record` primary constructors, `Version`, enums, arrays, and `List<T>`!). |
| `RsscManagedRuntime.InvokeAsync<T>(fnName, cancellationToken, params args)` | `.rssc` -> `.NET` | Awaits RaggieScript functions that call `async Task<T>` C# host delegates without blocking the UI thread. |
| `RsscManagedRuntime.BindDelegate<TDelegate>(fnOrClosureName)` | `.rssc` -> `.NET` | Compiles any RaggieScript `fn` or `=>` closure into a native strongly-typed C# `Func<...>` / `Action<...>` delegate via LINQ Expression Trees! |
| `RsscExecutionOptions` (`MaxSteps`, `Timeout`, `CancellationToken`, `Defines`) | Safety | Bounds AST statement execution (`MaxSteps = 250_000` default -> throws `RsscExecutionLimitException` on runaway `while (true)` loops), wall-clock timeouts, and cooperative cancellation. |
| `RsscManagedRuntime.RunTests()` | Test Runner | Executes all top-level `test "..." { ... }` blocks and returns `IReadOnlyList<RsscTestResult>` (`Name`, `Passed`, `DurationMs`, `ErrorMessage`). |
| `RsscManagedRuntime.StoreScript` & `Crossroads` | Consumer Sandboxes | Direct C# host access to `RsscStoreScriptEngine` (`LoadBuffer`, `GetBuffer`, `JsonDocumentText`) for *StoreTrainer* and `RsscCrossroadsEngine` (`OfferedOptions`, `Flags`, `Stats`) for *Book Reader*. |
| `RsscEs2022Transpiler.TryTranspile(program, out string mjs, out string err)` | `.rssc` -> `ES2022` | Pure-C# in-process transpiler emitting CSP-safe, zero-`eval()` ES2022 JavaScript modules for SCORM 1.2/2004 courses and Story Crossroads web scenes. |

#### 2. Complete Two-Way C# <-> RaggieScript Example {#dotnet-two-way-example}

```csharp
using RaggieSoft.RaggieScript;

// 1. Decorate a C# service or POCO — [RsscIgnore] hides internal secrets,
//    and System.Object.GetType() is NEVER exposed to untrusted scripts!
[RsscHostObject("storetrainer", RequiredCapability = "storetrainer")]
public sealed class StoreTrainerScriptService
{
    [RsscFunction("clampSlots")]
    public int ClampSlots(int requested) => Math.Clamp(requested, 1, 10);

    [RsscFunction("saveAuditAsync", Mutating = true)] // Blocked inside wizard {} via RSW701!
    public async Task<string> SaveAuditAsync(string title, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        await Task.Delay(5, ct);
        return $"saved:{title}";
    }

    [RsscIgnore]
    public string InternalSigningSecret => "never-visible-to-scripts";
}

public sealed record AuditSummary(string Title, int Slots, Version EngineVersion);

// 2. Register C# services, async delegates, and live POCOs on RsscHostEnvironment:
var host = new RsscHostEnvironment()
    .RegisterService(new StoreTrainerScriptService())
    .RegisterGlobalFunction("toSlug", (string s) => s.Trim().ToLowerInvariant().Replace(' ', '-'));

const string rsscSource = """
    use storetrainer;
    const isPassing = (score: int) => score >= 80;

    fn upgradeProfile(name: string, requestedSlots: int): map {
        const clamped = storetrainer.clampSlots(requestedSlots);
        storetrainer.saveAuditAsync(toSlug(name));
        return { title: name, slots: clamped, engineVersion: v"1.1.0.0" };
    }
    """;

// 3. Compile with full host-aware RSW701/RSW702/RSW712 static verification:
if (RsscCompiler.Compile(rsscSource, out var program, out var diagnostics, host))
{
    var options = new RsscExecutionOptions { MaxSteps = 100_000, Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2) };
    var runtime = new RsscManagedRuntime(program, host, options);

    // Await async C# delegates & hydrate RaggieScript map/struct straight into a C# record!
    AuditSummary? summary = await runtime.InvokeAsync<AuditSummary>(
        "upgradeProfile", cancellationToken, "Cedar Run Collector Profile", 50);

    // Or bind a RaggieScript '=>' closure directly as a native C# Func<int, bool>!
    Func<int, bool> checkScore = runtime.BindDelegate<Func<int, bool>>("isPassing");
    bool passed = checkScore(92); // true
}
```


================================================================================
TOPIC: Lexical Grammar, Preprocessor & Expressions [syntax-and-preprocessor] (Language Reference)
================================================================================

# Lexical Grammar, Preprocessor & Expressions {#syntax-and-preprocessor}

RaggieScript uses UTF-8 source files (`.rssc`) with C# / TypeScript-style curly-brace blocks, `;`-terminated statements, `//` line comments, and `/* ... */` block comments.

## Compile-Time Preprocessor & `include` {#preprocessor}

Before tokenization, RaggieScript resolves compile-time conditionals and modular `.rssc` includes:

| Directive | Example | Behavior |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `#define KEY VALUE` | `#define EDITION "Architect"` | Defines a compile-time macro constant readable via `def("KEY")` or `#ifdef`. |
| `#ifdef KEY` / `#ifndef KEY` | `#ifndef BOOK_SLUG` | Includes block when `KEY` was (or was not) passed via `-DKEY=VAL` or `#define`. |
| `#if` / `#elif` / `#else` / `#endif` | `#if TARGET_ARCH == "arm64"` | Conditional compilation supporting `==`, `!=`, `defined(KEY)`, `&&`, and `\|\|`. |
| `include "rel/path.rssc";` | `include "../includes/common.rssc";` | Splices reusable helper functions, `struct`s, and `enum`s with cycle protection. |

```rssc
#ifndef RELEASE_RING
#define RELEASE_RING "stable"
#endif

include "shared-enterprise-checks.rssc";
const activeRing = def("RELEASE_RING", "stable");
```

## Literals (`string`, Raw `r"..."`, Single `'...'`, `SemVer` `v"..."`) {#literals}

### 1. Interpolated Double-Quoted Strings (`"..."`) {#interpolated-strings}
Double-quoted strings expand `${expr}` expressions automatically (calling `str(expr)` on any inner expression) and support `\n`, `\r`, `\t`, `\\`, `\"`, and `\$` escapes:

```rssc
const summary = "Installing ${product.name} on ${sys.arch()} (Build ${sys.osBuild()})";
```

### 2. Single-Quoted Non-Interpolated Strings (`'...'`) {#single-quoted-strings}
Single-quoted strings do not expand `${...}` and can be nested cleanly inside `"${...}"` interpolations without escaping double quotes:

```rssc
log("Manufacturer: ${msi.getProperty(dbFile, 'Manufacturer')}");
```

### 3. Raw Windows Path & Registry Strings (`r"..."`) {#raw-strings}
Prefixing a string with `r` disables backslash escape processing—ideal for Windows Registry keys, UNC shares, and regular expressions:

```rssc
const uninstallKey = r"SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall";
```

### 4. First-Class Semantic Version Literals (`v"..."` & Bare 3-Part Versions) {#semver-literals}
Version literals parse into 4-part `Major.Minor.Build.Revision` 64-bit tuples so relational comparisons (`<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `==`, `!=`) never suffer lexicographical `"10.0.9" > "10.0.22000"` string bugs:

```rssc
const minWin11: version = v"10.0.22000.0";
if (sys.osVersion() >= minWin11) {
    log.info("Windows 11 or newer verified.");
}
```

### 5. Numbers, Booleans, Arrays & Maps {#collections-literals}
- **Integers (`int`)**: 64-bit signed (`42`, `-1`, `500_000`, hex `0x1040`).
- **Floats (`float`)**: 64-bit IEEE 754 (`4.5`, `0.25`).
- **Booleans & Null**: `true`, `false`, `null`.
- **Arrays (`array`)**: `[10, 20, 30]` (0-indexed, supports `+` concatenation).
- **Maps (`map`)**: `{ host: "https://raggiesoftstudio.com", port: 443 }`.

## Operators & Precedence (Highest to Lowest) {#operators}

| Precedence | Operators | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 (Postfix) | `obj.prop`, `obj?.prop`, `arr[i]`, `arr?.[i]`, `fn(a, name: b)` | Member access, **v1.3 null-safe optional chaining (`?.` / `?.[`)**, indexing, & calls |
| 2 (Unary) | `!x`, `-x`, `ref varName` | Logical NOT, numeric negation, two-way mutable `ref` binding |
| 3 (Multiplicative) | `*`, `/` (Path Join or Divide), `%` | When either operand is `path`, `a / b` joins path segments cleanly! |
| 4 (Additive) | `+`, `-` | Numeric add/subtract, string concatenation, or `array + array` merge |
| 5 (Relational) | `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=` | Numeric or 4-part `version` (`SemVer`) comparison |
| 6 (Equality) | `==`, `!=` | Deep structural value equality |
| 7 (Logical) | `&&`, `\|\|` | Short-circuit boolean AND / OR |
| 8 (Coalesce) | `lhs ?? rhs` | Evaluates to `rhs` when `lhs` is `null` or empty `""`; otherwise `lhs` |
| 9 (Conditional) | `cond ? whenTrue : whenFalse` | Ternary conditional expression |
| 10 (Assignment) | `=`, `+=`, `-=`, `*=`, `/=` | Mutable `let` / `param` assignment (`const` rejected by `RSW713`) |

## Control-Flow Statements {#control-flow}

```rssc
// 1. if / elif / else
if (sys.isArm64()) {
    log.info("ARM64 silicon");
} elif (sys.isX64()) {
    log.info("x64 silicon");
} else {
    exit(EXIT_UNSUPPORTED_OS);
}

// 2. for-in over arrays or (key, value) over maps
for (item in ["Core", "Docs"]) {
    log.info(item);
}
for (k, v in { channel: "stable", ring: "1" }) {
    log.info("${k}=${v}");
}

// 3. while & repeat-until loops (with break; and continue;)
let attempts = 0;
repeat {
    attempts += 1;
} until (attempts >= 3);

// 4. Structured exception handling & setup exit codes
try {
    assert(sys.freeDiskMB(installDir) >= 100, "At least 100 MB free space is required.");
} catch (err: string) {
    ui.error("Pre-Flight Check Failed", err);
    exit(1603);
}

// 5. v1.3 LIFO Scope-Exit Cleanup ('defer { ... }') & Optional Chaining ('?.')
fn inspectEndpoint(cfg: any) : int {
    defer { log.info("Finished inspecting endpoint configuration."); }
    return cfg?.network?.port ?? 8443;
}

// 6. v1.3 First-Class Unit Test Blocks ('raggiescript.exe test <file_or_dir> [--json]')
test "Optional chaining falls back to port 8443 when config is null" {
    assert(inspectEndpoint(null) == 8443, "Expected fallback port 8443");
}
```


================================================================================
TOPIC: Gradual Type System, struct, enum, match & Closures [types-structs-enums] (Language Reference)
================================================================================

# Gradual Type System, `struct`, `enum`, `match` & Closures {#types-structs-enums}

RaggieScript v1.0 features a **gradual, type-inferred static type checker (`BindAndVerifyProgram`)**. Simple setup scripts can omit type annotations entirely and rely on local type inference, while larger engineering suites can annotate `struct` schemas, `enum` variants, and `fn` return contracts checked at compile time (`RSW710`–`RSW715`).

## Built-In Primitive & Composite Types {#primitive-types}

| Type Annotation | Runtime Representation | Assignability & Widening Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `int` | 64-bit signed integer (`int64_t`) | Widens automatically to `float`. |
| `float` | 64-bit IEEE double (`double`) | Accepts both `float` and `int`. |
| `bool` | Boolean (`true` / `false`) | Strict in relational comparisons (`RSW711` blocks `<` on `bool`). |
| `string` | UTF-8 string | Interoperates cleanly with `path` and string-backed `enum` variants. |
| `path` | Normalized filesystem path | Supports `/` path-join operator (`sys.programFiles / "RaggieSoft"` -> `path`). |
| `version` | 4-part `SemVer` (`Major.Minor.Build.Rev`) | Compared component-wise (`v"10.0.22631" > v"10.0.22000"`). |
| `array` | Ordered list (`T[]` shorthand accepted) | Indexed via `arr[i]`; supports `len(arr)`, `array.map`, `array.filter`. |
| `map` | Key-value dictionary | Supports dot-property `m.key` and bracket `m["key"]` access. |
| `ref T` | Mutable variable reference | Required by two-way Wizard UI `bind: ref myParam` slots (`const` blocked by `RSW713`). |
| `any` | Gradual dynamic escape hatch | Compatible with any target or source type. |

## User-Defined Records (`struct`) {#structs}

`struct` declarations define strongly checked record types with optional default field values. Passing an unknown field name or wrong field type in a struct literal raises **`RSW714`** or **`RSW711`** at compile time (with a fuzzy `"Did you mean ...?"` suggestion!):

```rssc
struct EndpointConfig {
    host:       string = "https://raggiesoftstudio.com";
    port:       int    = 443;
    tlsVerify:  bool   = true;
}

const prod = EndpointConfig {
    port: 8443 // 'host' and 'tlsVerify' inherit their declared defaults!
};
```

## Strongly-Typed Enumerations (`enum`) {#enums}

`enum` declarations group named string or integer constants. Referencing a misspelled variant (`ReleaseRing.Stabel`) fails immediately at compile time with **`RSW714`**:

```rssc
enum ReleaseRing {
    Stable  = "stable",
    Preview = "preview",
    Lts     = "lts"
}

param ring: ReleaseRing = ReleaseRing.Stable;
```

## Pattern Matching (`match`) {#match-expressions}

`match` can be used as an **expression** (returning a value) or as a **statement**, with `_` (or `default`) serving as the wildcard catch-all arm:

```rssc
fn siliconBanner(arch: string) : string {
    return match (arch) {
        "arm64" => "Native Windows 11 ARM64 Build",
        "x64"   => "Native Windows 11 x64 Build",
        _       => "64-Bit Windows Build"
    };
}
```

## Functions (`fn`) & First-Class Arrow Closures (`=>`) {#functions-and-closures}

User functions support typed parameters, default parameter expressions, return type annotations (verified on all control paths via **`RSW715`**), and mutual recursion.

First-class arrow closures (`x => expr`, `(a: int, b: int) => expr`, or `() => { ... }`) capture lexical variables from outer scopes and compile to `MAKE_CLOSURE` opcodes in the `RSWBC2` stack VM:

```rssc
// 1. Named typed function with default argument
fn formatPortEndpoint(host: string, port: int = 443) : string {
    return "${host}:${port}";
}

// 2. First-class closure passed to ui.textBox(validate: ...) or array.filter(...)
const minPort = 1024;
const isValidServicePort = (raw: string) => {
    const p = int(str.trim(raw));
    return (p >= minPort && p <= 65535)
        ? Validation.ok()
        : Validation.error("Enter a TCP port between ${minPort} and 65535.");
};

const ports = [80, 443, 8080, 9443];
const unprivileged = array.filter(ports, p => p >= minPort); // -> [8080, 9443]
```


================================================================================
TOPIC: Package Headers, param, feature, payload & Phases [headers-and-phases] (Language Reference)
================================================================================

# Package Headers, `param`, `feature`, `payload` & Lifecycle Phases {#headers-and-phases}

Every RaggieScript installer, Showcase launchpad, or standalone micro-app follows a deterministic lifecycle designed so **interactive UI never mutates the machine** and **system mutations always roll back cleanly on failure**.

## Capability Declarations (`use <profile>;`) {#use-capabilities}

At the top of a `.rssc` file, `use` statements declare which Studio host capabilities the script is permitted to invoke:

- `use std;` — Core pure computation, strings, arrays, JSON, SemVer, and `sys.*` read-only queries (always implicitly available).
- `use ui;` — Declarative Wizard UI controls and `TaskDialogIndirect` prompts.
- `use installer;` — Full Windows packaging standard library (`fs.*`, `reg.*`, `msi.*`, `proc.*`, `ffi.*`, `svc.*`, `shortcut.*`, `arp.*`, `firewall.*`, `acl.*`).
- `use showcase;` — Interactive Showcase Studio canvas pages, accessible hotspots, and captioned audio.
- **Sandboxed Studio Profiles (`RSW702` enforced)**: `use training;`, `use a11y;`, `use localization;`, `use document;`, `use launcher;`, `use help;`.

## Top-Level Header Blocks (`package`, `showcase`, `app`) {#package-header}

```rssc
package "RaggieSoft Sample Workbench" {
    id:                    "{8C41E2B0-5D19-4A73-9E22-524147474945}";
    version:               v"1.2.0";
    publisher:             "RaggieSoft";
    tagline:               "Zero-Dependency Windows 11 Workstation";
    website:               "https://raggiesoftstudio.com";
    scope:                 Scope.Machine;           // Scope.User | Scope.Machine
    uac:                   Uac.Deferred;            // Uac.AsInvoker | Uac.HighestAvailable | Uac.RequireAdministrator | Uac.Deferred
    style:                 WizardStyle.FluentMica;  // Any of the 11 WizardStyle layouts
    supportDir:            "./_support";            // Embedded helper staging folder (#220)
    mainExe:               "SampleWorkbench.exe";
    icon:                  "assets/app.ico";
    accent:                "#0F766E";
    hideFromInstalledApps: false;                   // Sets SystemComponent=1 when true (for content packs!)
    autoPlayAudio:         false;                   // Enforced false per WCAG 2.2 AA
    minWindowsBuild:       22000;                   // Windows 11 floor
}
```

| Property | Accepted Aliases | Default | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `id` | `upgradeCode` | Auto UUIDv5 | Stable package/UpgradeCode identifier across upgrades. |
| `productCode` | — | Auto UUIDv4 | Optional explicit MSI `ProductCode` GUID. |
| `version` | — | `"1.0.0"` | 3- or 4-part version stamped into PE `VERSIONINFO` & Installed Apps. |
| `publisher` | `manufacturer` | `"RaggieSoft"` | Publisher name in UAC/TaskDialog banners and `Uninstall` registry keys. |
| `scope` | — | `Scope.Machine` | `Scope.User` (`%LOCALAPPDATA%` / `HKCU`) or `Scope.Machine` (`Program Files` / `HKLM`). |
| `uac` | `requestedExecutionLevel` | `Uac.Deferred` | Controls PE manifest `requestedExecutionLevel` and commit-time UAC broker. |
| `style` | `wizardLayout` | `WizardStyle.FluentMica` | Selects the native Win32 Per-Monitor V2 DPI wizard theme. |
| `supportDir` | — | `""` | Packs a local folder into `#220` (`__support__`) and extracts it to `sys.supportDir` at runtime. |
| `hideFromInstalledApps` | `systemComponent` | `false` | Sets `SystemComponent = 1` so 30+ book/album content packs never clutter Windows *Installed apps*. |

## `param`, `feature` & `payload` Declarations {#param-feature-payload}

```rssc
// 1. CLI-overridable setup parameter
param installDir: path = sys.programFiles / "RaggieSoft" / "Workbench";

// 2. Selectable installation feature (bound automatically to ui.featureTree!)
feature "Core" {
    title:       "Core Workstation";
    description: "Required native x64/ARM64 executables.";
    required:    true;
    inCompact:   true;
}

feature "CliSdk" {
    title:       "Command-Line Compiler & SDK";
    description: "Headless CI/CD tools and C++20 headers.";
    required:    false;
    inCompact:   false;
    selected:    true;
}

// 3. Embedded LZMS payload harvested at build time into RT_RCDATA #220 (RSWPAK1)
payload CoreFiles {
    from "../publish/win-${arch}/*";
    to:      installDir;
    feature: "Core";
}
```

## Execution Lifecycle Phases {#lifecycle-phases}

1. **Top-Level Pre-Flight Statements**: Run first (e.g., `verifyWindows11AndHardware(...)`).
2. **`wizard { step Name when (cond) { ... } }`**:
   - Automatically skipped when invoked in silent mode (`/s`, `/qn`, `--silent`).
   - Statically verified **100% side-effect-free (`RSW701`)**—including transitive calls through helper functions!
   - Navigating backward via **`<- Back`** pops the visited-step history stack so skipped conditional `when (...)` steps are never landed on in reverse.
3. **`install { ... }` (Commit Phase)**:
   - When `uac: Uac.Deferred` and `scope: Scope.Machine` are active and the process is not yet elevated, the wizard serializes user choices (`ExportWizardStateJson`) and launches `--elevated-rssc-worker` (`ShellExecuteExW(L"runas")`) right when **Install** is clicked!
   - Opens `.rsw-rollback.jnl` before the first mutation; commits and deletes `.rswbak` backups on success, or replays the journal in LIFO reverse order on any uncaught error, failed `assert()`, or user cancel!
4. **`repair(mode) { ... }` & `uninstall(purgeUserData) { ... }`**:
   - Invoked automatically by `<InstallDir>\Uninstall.exe --repair` or `--uninstall` (`Uninstall.rswm`).
5. **Showcase Event Handlers (`on page("Main").show`, `on hotspot("Btn").click`)**:
   - Bound directly to keyboard-accessible UI Automation hotspot peers in **RaggieSoft Showcase Studio**.


================================================================================
TOPIC: Global Functions, Enum Constants, Validation & compile.* [builtins-and-constants] (Language Reference)
================================================================================

# Global Built-In Functions, Enum Constants & `compile.*` / `feature.*` {#builtins-and-constants}

Global functions and built-in enum tables are available in **every** RaggieScript file without needing any namespace prefix.

## Global Built-In Functions (`16` Functions) {#global-functions}

| Signature | Return Type | Mutating? | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `str(value: any)` | `string` | Read-Only | Converts any RaggieScript value (`int`, `float`, `bool`, `path`, `version`, `array`, `map`) to UTF-8 text. |
| `int(value: any)` | `int` | Read-Only | Parses or truncates a `string`, `float`, or `bool` into a 64-bit signed integer (`0x...` hex supported). |
| `float(value: any)` | `float` | Read-Only | Converts a `string` or `int` into a 64-bit IEEE floating-point number. |
| `bool(value: any)` | `bool` | Read-Only | Evaluates RaggieScript truthiness (`false`, `null`, `0`, and `""` are `false`). |
| `path(value: any)` | `path` | Read-Only | Normalizes slashes into a first-class OS `path` value supporting the `/` path-join operator. |
| `ver(value: any)` | `version` | Read-Only | Parses `"10.0.22631.0"` into a 4-part `SemVer` value for component-wise `<` / `>=` comparisons. |
| `len(collectionOrStr: any)` | `int` | Read-Only | Returns character/byte length of a `string`, element count of an `array`, or key count of a `map`. |
| `typeof(value: any)` | `string` | Read-Only | Returns runtime type tag: `"null"`, `"bool"`, `"int"`, `"float"`, `"string"`, `"path"`, `"version"`, `"array"`, `"map"`, or `"closure"`. |
| `print(...values)` | `null` | Read-Only | Writes space-joined values to standard output (`stdout` / CLI console). |
| `log(message: string, level?: string)` | `null` | Read-Only | Appends a timestamped line to the structured setup log (`/l=install.log`). |
| `assert(condition: bool, message?: string)` | `bool` | Safe Gate | Raises an immediate runtime error if `condition` is `false`—automatically triggering LIFO rollback when inside `install { ... }`! |
| `sleep(milliseconds: int)` | `null` | Read-Only | Pauses script execution for `milliseconds` ms. |
| `coalesce(a: any, b: any, ...)` | `any` | Read-Only | Returns the first non-`null`, non-empty `""` argument (`a ?? b` operator equivalent). |
| `range(end: int)` / `range(start: int, end: int, step?: int)` | `array` | Read-Only | Produces an integer array `[start .. end)` for deterministic loops. |
| `def(name: string, fallback?: string)` | `string` | Read-Only | Reads a compile-time `-DNAME=VAL` CLI define or `#define` macro value (returning `fallback` if unset). |
| `targetArch()` | `string` | Read-Only | Returns the target compilation or native host architecture (`"arm64"` or `"x64"`). |

## Global Exit Constants & Built-In Enum Tables {#global-constants}

### Standard Exit Code Constants {#exit-constants}
- `EXIT_OK` (`0`) — Clean installation / execution success.
- `EXIT_ELEVATION_REQUIRED` (`740`) — `ERROR_ELEVATION_REQUIRED` when UAC is disabled (`EnableLUA = 0`) for a Standard User.
- `EXIT_REBOOT_NEEDED` (`3010`) — `ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED` signaling enterprise deployment tools that a restart is pending.
- `EXIT_UNSUPPORTED_OS` (`9007`) — Host OS build or RAM is below minimum package floor.
- `EXIT_PREREQ_MISSING` (`9008`) — Required prerequisite runtime was declined or unavailable.
- `EXIT_DOWNLOAD_FAILED` (`9009`) — Remote `.rswpak` or prerequisite download/SHA-256 verification failed.

### Built-In Enum & Metadata Maps {#builtin-enums}

| Global Table | Members | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `product` | `.id`, `.name`, `.version`, `.publisher`, `.scope`, `.uac`, `.style` | Read-only metadata mirror of the active `package` / `showcase` / `app` header! |
| `Scope` | `Scope.User` (`"user"`), `Scope.Machine` (`"machine"`) | Selects per-user (`%LOCALAPPDATA%`) vs. per-machine (`Program Files`) installation scope. |
| `Uac` | `Uac.AsInvoker`, `Uac.HighestAvailable`, `Uac.RequireAdministrator`, `Uac.Deferred` | Controls PE UAC manifest & deferred commit-time elevation broker. |
| `Hive` | `Hive.HKCU`, `Hive.HKLM`, `Hive.HKCR`, `Hive.HKU` | Windows Registry root hive constants for `reg.*` calls. |
| `RegView` | `RegView.Native64`, `RegView.Wow32`, `RegView.Both` | Per-call stateless 64-bit / 32-bit WOW64 Registry view selector (`KEY_WOW64_64KEY` / `32KEY`). |
| `Token` | `Token.Current`, `Token.Elevated`, `Token.Desktop` | Process token selector for `proc.run()` (`Token.Desktop` de-elevates via `explorer.exe`!). |
| `Icon` | `Icon.Info`, `Icon.Warning`, `Icon.Error`, `Icon.Shield` | Accessible glyph selector for `ui.taskDialog()` and `ui.notice()`. |
| `SetupMode` | `SetupMode.Express`, `SetupMode.Compact`, `SetupMode.Custom`, `SetupMode.Complete` | Standard installation preset identifiers. |
| `WizardStyle` | `Standard`, `Wizard95`, `Wizard97`, `AeroWizard`, `FluentMica`, `OneClick`, `PassiveToast`, `FullScreenBlue`, `FullScreenTeal`, `Autorun16x9`, `Simple` | Selects any of the 11 native Per-Monitor V2 DPI Win32 wizard layouts. |
| `Delivery` | `Delivery.Embedded`, `Delivery.Download` | Marks a `feature` as embedded inside `#220` or fetched from a SHA-256 verified `.rswpak` URL. |

## `Validation.*` — Wizard Input Validation Helpers {#validation-namespace}

Used inside `validate: (val) => ...` closures on `ui.textBox`, `ui.folderPicker`, and `ui.filePicker` to gate the **Next >** button with inline accessible error banners (zero modal `MessageBox` spam!):

| Method | Signature | Return Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `Validation.ok` | `Validation.ok()` | `map` | Returns `{ ok: true, message: "" }`, clearing any inline field error and enabling **Next >**. |
| `Validation.error` | `Validation.error(message: string)` | `map` | Returns `{ ok: false, message }`, focusing the invalid field and announcing `message` to screen readers. |

## `compile.*` — Build-Time Asset Embedding {#compile-namespace}

`compile.*` calls execute **at compile time** during `raggiescript.exe compile` / `pack-exe` / `instbuild.exe` and bake the resulting JSON object or text string directly into the `RSWBC2` constant pool—requiring zero external files at runtime!

| Method | Signature | Return Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `compile.json` | `compile.json(relativePath: string)` | `any` | Parses a JSON file at build time and embeds the structured map/array into bytecode. |
| `compile.text` | `compile.text(relativePath: string)` | `string` | Reads a UTF-8 text/Markdown/RTF file at build time and embeds it as a string constant. |
| `compile.def` | `compile.def(key: string, fallback?: string)` | `string` | Alias for `def(key, fallback)` reading `-DKEY=VAL` or `#define`. |
| `compile.define` | `compile.define(key: string, fallback?: string)` | `string` | Alias for `compile.def(key, fallback)`. |

## `payload.*` & `feature.*` — Package Feature & Payload Inspection {#feature-namespace}

| Method | Signature | Return Type | Mutating? | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `payload.dir` | `payload.dir(payloadId: string)` | `path` | Read-Only | Resolves the extracted staging directory path for a declared `payload`. |
| `payload.path` | `payload.path(payloadId: string)` | `path` | Read-Only | Resolves the extracted file or directory path for `payloadId`. |
| `feature.list` | `feature.list()` | `array` | Read-Only | Returns an array of `{ id, title, description, selected, required, inCompact }` maps for all declared `feature` blocks. |
| `feature.info` | `feature.info(featureId: string)` | `map` | Read-Only | Returns the metadata and selection map for `featureId`. |
| `feature.isSelected` | `feature.isSelected(featureId: string)` | `bool` | Read-Only | Returns `true` if `featureId` is currently checked for installation. |
| `feature.setSelected` | `feature.setSelected(featureId: string, selected?: bool)` | `bool` | Wizard-Safe | Programmatically toggles a non-required feature's selection state (`false` ignored on `required: true` features). |
| `feature.setState` | `feature.setState(featureId: string, selected?: bool)` | `bool` | Wizard-Safe | Alias for `feature.setSelected(...)`. |
| `feature.selectPreset` | `feature.selectPreset(preset?: string)` | `bool` | Wizard-Safe | Applies `"express"`, `"compact"`, or `"complete"` selection tiers across all declared features. |


================================================================================
TOPIC: sys.* — Silicon, OS Kernel, UAC, Folders & Reboot [ns-sys] (Core Standard Library)
================================================================================

# `sys.*` — Silicon, OS Kernel, UAC, Known Folders & Reboot Resume {#ns-sys}

The `sys.*` namespace exposes **true un-shimmed Windows 11 hardware, silicon, kernel, display, accessibility, and known-folder queries** without ever flipping global 32-bit/64-bit state variables.

> [!NOTE] Every read-only query in `sys.*` (`40` methods + `26` properties) is **100% `RSW701` Wizard-Safe**. Only the 3 reboot-scheduling persistence calls (`clearResumeState`, `scheduleResumeAfterReboot`, `rebootAndResume`) mutate `RunOnce` state and require `install { ... }`.

## CPU Silicon & Windows Kernel Version Queries {#sys-silicon-os}

Unlike legacy installers that call `GetVersionExW` (which lies unless shimmed) or check `PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE` (which returns `"AMD64"` inside an x64 process emulated under ARM64 Prism!), `sys.*` calls **`ntdll.dll!RtlGetVersion`** and **`kernel32.dll!IsWow64Process2`** directly:

| Call | Signature | Return | Mutating? | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `sys.arch` | `sys.arch()` | `string` | Read-Only | Returns true physical host CPU silicon: `"arm64"` or `"x64"` (pierces WOW64 & Prism emulation!). |
| `sys.compiledArch` | `sys.compiledArch()` | `string` | Read-Only | Returns the compiled PE architecture of the running binary (`"arm64"` or `"x64"`). |
| `sys.isArm64` | `sys.isArm64()` | `bool` | Read-Only | `true` when physical host silicon is native ARM64 (`IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64`). |
| `sys.isX64` | `sys.isX64()` | `bool` | Read-Only | `true` when physical host silicon is x64 / AMD64 (`IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64`). |
| `sys.isEmulatedUnderPrism` | `sys.isEmulatedUnderPrism()` | `bool` | Read-Only | `true` when an x64/x86 process is running under Windows 11 ARM64 Prism translation. |
| `sys.osBuild` | `sys.osBuild()` | `int` | Read-Only | Un-shimmed kernel build via `RtlGetVersion` (`22000+` = Windows 11, `26100+` = 24H2). |
| `sys.osVersion` | `sys.osVersion()` | `version` | Read-Only | Un-shimmed 4-part SemVer OS version (e.g., `v"10.0.26100.0"`). |
| `sys.isWindows11` | `sys.isWindows11()` | `bool` | Read-Only | `true` when `sys.osBuild() >= 22000`. |
| `sys.isServer` | `sys.isServer()` | `bool` | Read-Only | `true` on Windows Server SKUs (`VER_NT_SERVER` / `VER_NT_DOMAIN_CONTROLLER`). |
| `sys.editionId` | `sys.editionId()` | `string` | Read-Only | Reads Windows `EditionID` (`"Professional"`, `"Enterprise"`, `"Education"`, etc.). |

## Privileges, UAC, Command-Line & Execution Mode {#sys-uac-cli}

| Call | Signature | Return | Mutating? | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `sys.isAdmin` | `sys.isAdmin()` | `bool` | Read-Only | `true` when running with effective Administrator token membership (`CheckTokenMembership`). |
| `sys.uacEnabled` | `sys.uacEnabled()` | `bool` | Read-Only | `true` when `HKLM\...\Policies\System\EnableLUA != 0`. Crucial before prompting UAC for Standard Users! |
| `sys.canPromptUac` | `sys.canPromptUac()` | `bool` | Read-Only | `true` when not silent and Windows can present an interactive elevation consent dialog. |
| `sys.isSilent` | `sys.isSilent()` | `bool` | Read-Only | `true` when invoked with `/s`, `/S`, `/qn`, `/quiet`, or `--silent`. |
| `sys.isPassive` | `sys.isPassive()` | `bool` | Read-Only | `true` when invoked with `/passive` or `/qb` (progress-only mode). |
| `sys.isMaintenance` | `sys.isMaintenance()` | `bool` | Read-Only | `true` when invoked in `--repair` or `--uninstall` maintenance mode. |
| `sys.cmdLine` | `sys.cmdLine()` | `string` | Read-Only | Returns the full raw Win32 command line (`GetCommandLineW`). |
| `sys.cliArg` | `sys.cliArg(key: string, fallback?: string)` | `string` | Read-Only | Reads a CLI `KEY=VAL` or `KEY:VAL` property, or `fallback` if omitted. |
| `sys.hasSwitch` | `sys.hasSwitch(flag: string)` | `bool` | Read-Only | Case-insensitive check for a CLI switch (`sys.hasSwitch("--offline")`). |

## Hardware, Display, Accessibility & Identity {#sys-hardware-a11y}

| Call | Signature | Return | Mutating? | Description |

| `sys.freeDiskMB` | `sys.freeDiskMB(targetPath?: path)` | `int` | Read-Only | Available free megabytes on the volume backing `targetPath`. |
| `sys.screenWidth` | `sys.screenWidth()` | `int` | Read-Only | Primary display width in physical pixels. |
| `sys.screenHeight` | `sys.screenHeight()` | `int` | Read-Only | Primary display height in physical pixels. |
| `sys.dpi` | `sys.dpi()` | `int` | Read-Only | Primary monitor DPI (`96` = 100%, `144` = 150%, `192` = 200%). |
| `sys.isDarkMode` | `sys.isDarkMode()` | `bool` | Read-Only | `true` when `AppsUseLightTheme == 0` in `Personalize`. |
| `sys.isHighContrast` | `sys.isHighContrast()` | `bool` | Read-Only | `true` when a Windows Contrast Theme (`SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST` / `HCF_HIGHCONTRASTON`) is active! |
| `sys.locale` | `sys.locale()` | `string` | Read-Only | User default BCP-47 locale tag (`GetUserDefaultLocaleName`, e.g., `"en-US"`). |
| `sys.computerName` | `sys.computerName()` | `string` | Read-Only | Local NetBIOS/DNS computer name. |
| `sys.userName` | `sys.userName()` | `string` | Read-Only | Current interactive account name. |
| `sys.userSid` | `sys.userSid()` | `string` | Read-Only | String SID (`"S-1-5-21-..."`) of the current process token (`ConvertSidToStringSidW`). |
| `sys.machineGuid` | `sys.machineGuid()` | `string` | Read-Only | Native 64-bit `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Cryptography\MachineGuid`. |
| `sys.newGuid` | `sys.newGuid()` | `string` | Read-Only | Generates a fresh cryptographic `{XXXXXXXX-XXXX-4XXX-...}` UUIDv4 (`BCryptGenRandom`). |
| `sys.uuid5` | `sys.uuid5(name: string, namespaceGuid?: string)` | `string` | Read-Only | Generates a deterministic RFC 4122 SHA-1 UUIDv5 `{GUID}` (identical across `x64` & `ARM64` builds). |
| `sys.folder` | `sys.folder(knownName: string)` | `path` | Read-Only | Resolves known folders by name: `"ProgramFiles"`, `"ProgramFilesX86"`, `"LocalAppData"`, `"RoamingAppData"`, `"ProgramData"`, `"Desktop"`, `"StartMenu"`, `"Documents"`, `"Fonts"`, `"Windows"`, `"System32"`, `"Temp"`. |

| `sys.getResumeState` | `sys.getResumeState(id?: string)` | `any` | Read-Only | Loads persisted JSON resume state map written before an OS restart (or `null` on fresh run). |
| `sys.clearResumeState` | `sys.clearResumeState(id?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Deletes persisted resume JSON and cleans up the `RunOnce` continuation entry. |
| `sys.scheduleResumeAfterReboot` | `sys.scheduleResumeAfterReboot(stateMap?: map, id?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Persists `stateMap` and registers `CurrentVersion\RunOnce` to re-launch setup after sign-in. |
| `sys.rebootAndResume` | `sys.rebootAndResume(stateMap?: map, id?: string)` | `path` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Persists `stateMap`, registers `RunOnce`, sets `rebootLatch(true)`, and returns the state file path. |

## All `26` `sys.*` Read-Only Properties {#sys-properties}

Every path property returns a first-class `path` ready for `/` path joining (`sys.programFiles / "RaggieSoft" / "Studio"`):

| Property | Type | Resolved Native Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `sys.programFiles` | `path` | Native 64-bit `C:\Program Files` (never redirected to `(x86)`!) |
| `sys.programFilesX86` | `path` | Explicit 32-bit `C:\Program Files (x86)` |
| `sys.commonFiles` | `path` | Native 64-bit `C:\Program Files\Common Files` |
| `sys.commonFilesX86` | `path` | Explicit 32-bit `C:\Program Files (x86)\Common Files` |
| `sys.localAppData` | `path` | Current user `%LOCALAPPDATA%` (`C:\Users\<Name>\AppData\Local`) |
| `sys.roamingAppData` | `path` | Current user `%APPDATA%` (`C:\Users\<Name>\AppData\Roaming`) |
| `sys.programData` | `path` | Shared machine `C:\ProgramData` |
| `sys.desktopDir` | `path` | Current user Desktop folder |
| `sys.commonDesktopDir` / `sys.publicDesktopDir` | `path` | All-Users `C:\Users\Public\Desktop` |
| `sys.startMenuDir` / `sys.startMenuPrograms` | `path` | Current user Start Menu `Programs` folder |
| `sys.commonStartMenuDir` / `sys.commonStartMenuPrograms` | `path` | All-Users Start Menu `Programs` folder |
| `sys.documentsDir` | `path` | Current user `Documents` folder |
| `sys.publicDocumentsDir` | `path` | All-Users `C:\Users\Public\Documents` |
| `sys.fontsDir` | `path` | System `C:\Windows\Fonts` |
| `sys.windowsDir` | `path` | `C:\Windows` |
| `sys.system32Dir` | `path` | True 64-bit `C:\Windows\System32` |
| `sys.sysWow64Dir` | `path` | 32-bit `C:\Windows\SysWOW64` |
| `sys.tempDir` | `path` | Process `%TEMP%` folder |
| `sys.exePath` | `path` | Full path to the running setup / packed `.exe` |
| `sys.exeDir` | `path` | Parent directory containing the running `.exe` |
| `sys.supportDir` | `path` | Extracted `_support\` helper directory (when bundled) |
| `sys.windowsBuild` | `int` | Property alias for `sys.osBuild()` |
| `sys.isSilent` | `bool` | Property alias for `sys.isSilent()` |


================================================================================
TOPIC: str.*, regex.*, array.*, map.*, time.*, math.*, json.*, ini.* & xml.* [ns-data-and-text] (Core Standard Library)
================================================================================

# `str.*`, `regex.*`, `array.*`, `map.*`, `time.*`, `math.*`, `json.*`, `ini.*` & `xml.*` {#ns-data-and-text}

Pure string, regular expression, functional array/map, ISO-8601 time, numeric math, and JSON helpers work across **every** RaggieScript target (C++20 VM, `.NET` `RaggieScript.Core`, and SCORM/Crossroads `ES2022`), while `.ini` and `.xml` file mutations participate automatically in `.rsw-rollback.jnl` backups!

## `str.*` — UTF-8 String Manipulation (`12` Methods) {#str-namespace}

| Method | Signature | Return | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `str.len` | `str.len(text: string)` | `int` | Returns length of `text`. |
| `str.lower` | `str.lower(text: string)` | `string` | Returns lowercase copy of `text`. |
| `str.upper` | `str.upper(text: string)` | `string` | Returns uppercase copy of `text`. |
| `str.trim` | `str.trim(text: string)` | `string` | Strips leading and trailing ASCII/Unicode whitespace. |
| `str.contains` | `str.contains(haystack: string, needle: string, ignoreCase?: bool)` | `bool` | Returns `true` if `needle` appears in `haystack`. |
| `str.startsWith` | `str.startsWith(text: string, prefix: string, ignoreCase?: bool)` | `bool` | Returns `true` if `text` begins with `prefix`. |
| `str.endsWith` | `str.endsWith(text: string, suffix: string, ignoreCase?: bool)` | `bool` | Returns `true` if `text` ends with `suffix`. |
| `str.indexOf` | `str.indexOf(haystack: string, needle: string, startIndex?: int)` | `int` | Returns 0-based index of `needle`, or `-1` when absent. |
| `str.replace` | `str.replace(text: string, oldSub: string, newSub: string, ignoreCase?: bool)` | `string` | Replaces all occurrences of `oldSub` with `newSub`. |
| `str.split` | `str.split(text: string, delimiter?: string)` | `array` | Splits `text` on `delimiter` (default `"\n"`) into a `string[]` array. |
| `str.join` | `str.join(items: array, separator?: string)` | `string` | Joins array elements with `separator` (default `""`). |
| `str.slice` | `str.slice(text: string, start: int, end?: int)` | `string` | Extracts substring `[start, end)`. |

## `regex.*` — ECMAScript Regular Expressions (`3` Methods) {#regex-namespace}

| Method | Signature | Return | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `regex.isMatch` | `regex.isMatch(input: string, pattern: string, ignoreCase?: bool)` | `bool` | Returns `true` if `input` matches ECMAScript regex `pattern`. |
| `regex.match` | `regex.match(input: string, pattern: string, ignoreCase?: bool)` | `array` | Returns `[fullMatch, group1, group2, ...]` for the first match (or `[]` if none). |
| `regex.replace` | `regex.replace(input: string, pattern: string, replacement: string, ignoreCase?: bool)` | `string` | Replaces regex matches using standard `$1`, `$2` replacement groups. |

## `array.*` — Functional Collection Operations (`12` Methods) {#array-namespace}

`array.map`, `array.filter`, `array.find`, `array.any`, `array.all`, and `array.reduce` invoke first-class RaggieScript closures (`item => ...`) directly inside the linear stack VM, `.NET` runtime, and `ES2022`:

| Method | Signature | Return | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `array.push` | `array.push(list: array, item: any)` | `int` | Appends `item` and returns the new length. |
| `array.map` | `array.map(list: array, transformFn: fn)` | `array` | Calls `transformFn(item)` for each element and returns the mapped array. |
| `array.filter` | `array.filter(list: array, predicateFn: fn)` | `array` | Keeps elements for which `predicateFn(item)` returns truthy. |
| `array.contains` | `array.contains(list: array, needle: any)` | `bool` | Structural equality membership check. |
| `array.find` | `array.find(list: array, predicateFn: fn)` | `any` | Returns the first element matching `predicateFn(item)`, or `null`. |
| `array.any` | `array.any(list: array, predicateFn: fn)` | `bool` | Returns `true` if at least one element satisfies `predicateFn(item)`. |
| `array.all` | `array.all(list: array, predicateFn: fn)` | `bool` | Returns `true` if every element satisfies `predicateFn(item)`. |
| `array.reduce` | `array.reduce(list: array, initial: any, reducerFn: fn)` | `any` | Folds `list` left-to-right via `(acc, item) => nextAcc`. |
| `array.sort` | `array.sort(list: array)` | `array` | Returns a sorted copy (preserving `SemVer`, numeric, and UTF-8 ordering). |
| `array.unique` | `array.unique(list: array)` | `array` | Returns a copy with duplicate values removed while preserving first-seen order. |
| `array.slice` | `array.slice(list: array, start: int, end?: int)` | `array` | Extracts sub-array `[start, end)`. |
| `array.reverse` | `array.reverse(list: array)` | `array` | Returns a reversed copy of `list`. |

```rssc
const rawPorts = [" 443 ", " 8080 ", " 80 "];
const highPorts = array.filter(
    array.map(rawPorts, s => int(str.trim(s))),
    p => p >= 1024
); // -> [8080]
```

## `map.*` — Dictionary & Struct Inspection (`6` Methods) {#map-namespace}

| Method | Signature | Return | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `map.keys` | `map.keys(record: map)` | `array` | Returns sorted key names of `record` (excluding internal `__struct` tags). |
| `map.values` | `map.values(record: map)` | `array` | Returns values stored in `record`. |
| `map.entries` | `map.entries(record: map)` | `array` | Returns `[key, value]` two-element pairs for `record`. |
| `map.has` | `map.has(record: map, key: string)` | `bool` | Returns `true` if `record` defines `key`. |
| `map.merge` | `map.merge(baseMap: map, patchMap: map)` | `map` | Returns a shallow-merged copy of `baseMap` overwritten by `patchMap`. |
| `map.remove` | `map.remove(record: map, key: string)` | `bool` | Deletes `key` in place and returns `true` if it was present. |

## `time.*` — ISO-8601 Timestamps, Monotonic Stopwatch & SCORM Durations (`9` Methods) {#time-namespace}

| Method | Signature | Return | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `time.nowUtc` | `time.nowUtc()` | `string` | Current UTC timestamp in ISO-8601 format (`"2026-11-27T23:45:00Z"`). |
| `time.nowLocal` | `time.nowLocal()` | `string` | Current local timestamp (`"2026-11-27T18:45:00"`). |
| `time.unixSeconds` | `time.unixSeconds()` | `int` | Current Unix epoch timestamp in seconds. |
| `time.unixMillis` | `time.unixMillis()` | `int` | Current Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. |
| `time.stopwatchMs` | `time.stopwatchMs()` | `int` | High-resolution monotonic elapsed milliseconds (`QueryPerformanceCounter` / `Stopwatch`). |
| `time.formatUtc` | `time.formatUtc(unixSeconds: int, pattern?: string)` | `string` | Formats `unixSeconds` in UTC (`"ISO8601"`, `"YYYY-MM-DD"`, `"YYYYMMDD-HHmmss"`, or `strftime`). |
| `time.formatLocal` | `time.formatLocal(unixSeconds: int, pattern?: string)` | `string` | Formats `unixSeconds` in local time. |
| `time.parseIso` | `time.parseIso(isoString: string)` | `int` | Parses an ISO-8601 UTC date/timestamp into Unix epoch seconds. |
| `time.formatScormDuration` | `time.formatScormDuration(seconds: float)` | `string` | Formats elapsed seconds as a SCORM 2004 4th Edition ISO-8601 duration (`"PT14M22S"`). |

## `math.*` — Clamping, Interpolation & Numeric Constants (`10` Methods + `2` Properties) {#math-namespace}

Includes built-in constants **`math.PI`** (`3.141592653589793`) and **`math.E`** (`2.718281828459045`):

| Method | Signature | Return | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `math.min` | `math.min(a: any, b: any)` | `int \| float` | Returns the smaller of `a` and `b`. |
| `math.max` | `math.max(a: any, b: any)` | `int \| float` | Returns the larger of `a` and `b`. |
| `math.clamp` | `math.clamp(value: any, minVal: any, maxVal: any)` | `int \| float` | Clamps `value` into `[minVal, maxVal]`. |
| `math.abs` | `math.abs(x: any)` | `int \| float` | Returns absolute magnitude of `x`. |
| `math.round` | `math.round(x: float, digits?: int)` | `float` | Rounds `x` to `digits` decimal places (`0` by default). |
| `math.floor` | `math.floor(x: float)` | `int` | Largest integer `<= x`. |
| `math.ceil` | `math.ceil(x: float)` | `int` | Smallest integer `>= x`. |
| `math.pow` | `math.pow(base: float, exponent: float)` | `float` | Computes `base` raised to `exponent`. |
| `math.sqrt` | `math.sqrt(x: float)` | `float` | Computes non-negative square root of `x`. |
| `math.lerp` | `math.lerp(a: float, b: float, t: float)` | `float` | Linear interpolation `a + (b - a) * t`. |

## `json.*` — Structured JSON Parse & Serialize (`2` Methods) {#json-namespace}

| Method | Signature | Return | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `json.parse` | `json.parse(jsonText: string)` | `any` | Parses UTF-8 JSON into nested RaggieScript `map`s, `array`s, and primitives. |
| `json.stringify` | `json.stringify(value: any, pretty?: bool)` | `string` | Serializes any value (including `struct` instances) to valid comment-free UTF-8 JSON. |

## `ini.*` & `xml.*` — Configuration File Surgery (`8` Methods) {#ini-xml-namespaces}

> [!IMPORTANT] `ini.write`, `ini.deleteKey`, `xml.replaceAttr`, and `xml.setElementText` are marked **Mutating (`RSW701`)**: they automatically snapshot the original file to `.rswbak` before editing so failed installations restore existing user configs byte-for-byte!

| Method | Signature | Return | Mutating? | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ini.read` | `ini.read(file: path, section: string, key: string, fallback?: string)` | `string` | Read-Only | Reads `[section] key` from a UTF-8/UTF-16 `.ini` file. |
| `ini.sections` | `ini.sections(file: path)` | `array` | Read-Only | Lists all `[Section]` names in `file`. |
| `ini.write` | `ini.write(file: path, section: string, key: string, value: any)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Writes `[section] key=value` with automatic `.rswbak` rollback backup. |
| `ini.deleteKey` | `ini.deleteKey(file: path, section: string, key: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Deletes `key` from `[section]` (rollback-protected). |
| `xml.readText` | `xml.readText(file: path, elementTagOrPath: string, fallback?: string)` | `string` | Read-Only | Reads inner text of a matching XML element. |
| `xml.readAttr` | `xml.readAttr(file: path, elementTag: string, attrName: string, fallback?: string)` | `string` | Read-Only | Reads `attrName` from an XML element. |
| `xml.replaceAttr` | `xml.replaceAttr(file: path, elementTag: string, attrName: string, newValue: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Updates an XML attribute value in-place with `.rswbak` rollback protection. |
| `xml.setElementText` | `xml.setElementText(file: path, elementTag: string, innerText: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Updates inner text of an XML element with `.rswbak` rollback protection. |


================================================================================
TOPIC: fs.* & reg.* — Transactional Filesystem & Registry [ns-fs-and-reg] (Core Standard Library)
================================================================================

# `fs.*` & `reg.*` — Transactional Filesystem & Stateless 64/32-Bit Registry {#ns-fs-and-reg}

`fs.*` and `reg.*` are gated to `use installer;` (and `use showcase;` in Community/Architect editions; blocked in sandboxed profiles via `RSW702`). Every mutating call is **100% rollback-journaled** inside `install { ... }` and rejected inside `wizard { ... }` by **`RSW701`**.

## `fs.*` — Read-Only Inspection & Cryptographic Verification (`19` Methods) {#fs-readonly}

| Method | Signature | Return | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `fs.exists` | `fs.exists(target: path)` | `bool` | Returns `true` if file or directory exists. |
| `fs.isDir` | `fs.isDir(target: path)` | `bool` | Returns `true` if `target` is an existing directory. |
| `fs.isFile` | `fs.isFile(target: path)` | `bool` | Returns `true` if `target` is a regular file. |
| `fs.isLocked` | `fs.isLocked(file: path)` | `bool` | Probes `CreateFileW` with exclusive sharing (`0`) to check if another process holds a file lock. |
| `fs.size` | `fs.size(file: path)` | `int` | Returns file size in bytes (`0` if missing). |
| `fs.join` | `fs.join(part1: any, part2: any, ...)` | `path` | Joins up to 8 path segments cleanly (functional equivalent of `a / b`). |
| `fs.parent` | `fs.parent(target: path)` | `path` | Returns the parent directory path. |
| `fs.fileName` | `fs.fileName(target: path)` | `string` | Returns filename including extension (`"Workbench.exe"`). |
| `fs.stem` | `fs.stem(target: path)` | `string` | Returns filename without extension (`"Workbench"`). |
| `fs.ext` | `fs.ext(target: path)` | `string` | Returns extension including leading dot (`".exe"`). |
| `fs.tempDir` | `fs.tempDir(subName?: string)` | `path` | Resolves or allocates a scoped directory inside `%TEMP%`. |
| `fs.tempFile` | `fs.tempFile(prefix?: string, ext?: string)` | `path` | Allocates a unique temporary file path. |
| `fs.fileVersion` | `fs.fileVersion(pePath: path)` | `version` | Reads PE `VS_FIXEDFILEINFO` (`GetFileVersionInfoW`) as a 4-part `SemVer` value! |
| `fs.sha256` | `fs.sha256(file: path)` | `string` | Computes lowercase 64-char hex SHA-256 via Windows CNG `bcrypt.dll`. |
| `fs.verifyAuthenticode` | `fs.verifyAuthenticode(pePath: path)` | `bool` | Verifies PE Authenticode signature chain via `WinVerifyTrust(WINTRUST_ACTION_GENERIC_VERIFY_V2)`. |
| `fs.findFiles` | `fs.findFiles(dir: path, pattern?: string, recursive?: bool)` | `array` | Enumerates matching file `path` items in `dir`. |
| `fs.readText` | `fs.readText(file: path)` | `string` | Reads a UTF-8 text file (stripping optional UTF-8 BOM). |
| `fs.readLines` | `fs.readLines(file: path)` | `array` | Reads UTF-8 lines into a `string[]` array. |
| `fs.readJson` | `fs.readJson(file: path)` | `any` | Reads and parses a UTF-8 JSON file into maps/arrays/primitives. |

## `fs.*` — Rollback-Journaled Mutations & `RSWPAK1` Extraction (`15` Methods) {#fs-mutating}

| Method | Signature | Return | Rollback Behavior (`.rsw-rollback.jnl`) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `fs.writeText` | `fs.writeText(file: path, content: string)` | `bool` | Snapshots existing file to `.rswbak` (or records created file for deletion on fault). |
| `fs.appendText` | `fs.appendText(file: path, text: string)` | `bool` | Snapshots prior file bytes to `.rswbak` before appending. |
| `fs.writeJson` | `fs.writeJson(file: path, value: any, pretty?: bool)` | `bool` | Atomically serializes structured JSON (with `.rswbak` protection). |
| `fs.writeBytesHex` | `fs.writeBytesHex(file: path, hexString: string)` | `bool` | Writes decoded binary bytes with `.rswbak` rollback protection. |
| `fs.mkdir` | `fs.mkdir(dir: path)` | `bool` | Creates missing parent/target directories and journals newly created folders in LIFO order. |
| `fs.copy` | `fs.copy(src: path, dst: path, overwrite?: bool)` | `bool` | Copies `src` -> `dst` (`overwrite = true` default), backing up any prior `dst` to `.rswbak`. |
| `fs.copyTree` | `fs.copyTree(srcDir: path, dstDir: path, progressLabel?: string)` | `bool` | Recursively copies an entire directory tree with per-file rollback entries. |
| `fs.move` | `fs.move(src: path, dst: path)` | `bool` | Moves/renames `src` -> `dst` with rollback restoration. |
| `fs.remove` | `fs.remove(file: path)` | `bool` | Backs up `file` to `.rswbak` during `install` so fault rollback restores deleted files! |
| `fs.removeDir` | `fs.removeDir(dir: path)` | `bool` | Removes directory tree if present. |
| `fs.removeTree` | `fs.removeTree(dir: path)` | `bool` | Alias for `fs.removeDir(dir)`. |
| `fs.removeTreeIfExists` | `fs.removeTreeIfExists(dir: path)` | `bool` | Safely removes `dir` without error when already absent. |
| `fs.setAttributes` | `fs.setAttributes(target: path, readOnly?: bool, hidden?: bool, system?: bool)` | `bool` | Updates Win32 file attributes (`SetFileAttributesW`). |
| `fs.setNtfsCompression` | `fs.setNtfsCompression(target: path, enabled?: bool)` | `bool` | Enables/disables transparent NTFS `LZNT1` compression (`FSCTL_SET_COMPRESSION`). |
| `fs.extract` | `fs.extract(payloadId?: string, to?: path, feature?: string)` | `int` | Extracts embedded `LZMS` `RSWPAK1` (`#220`) files into `to` (default `installDir`), returning extracted file count! |

## `reg.*` — Stateless 64-Bit & 32-Bit WOW64 Windows Registry (`13` Methods) {#reg-namespace}

> [!TIP] Never toggle global `SetRegView 64` / `SetRegView 32` state! Every `reg.*` call defaults to `RegView.Native64` (`KEY_WOW64_64KEY`) and accepts a stateless per-call `view: RegView.Native64 | RegView.Wow32 | RegView.Both` named argument.

| Method | Signature | Return | Mutating? | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `reg.exists` | `reg.exists(hive: string, key: string, valueName?: string, view?: string)` | `bool` | Read-Only | Checks whether `key` (or `valueName` when non-empty) exists. |
| `reg.read` | `reg.read(hive: string, key: string, valueName: string, fallback?: any, view?: string)` | `any` | Read-Only | Reads string or integer value—returning `null` when absent so `??` null-coalescing chains work naturally! |
| `reg.readString` | `reg.readString(hive: string, key: string, valueName: string, fallback?: string, view?: string)` | `string` | Read-Only | Reads `REG_SZ` or `REG_EXPAND_SZ` string (returning `fallback` or `""` when missing). |
| `reg.readDword` | `reg.readDword(hive: string, key: string, valueName: string, fallback?: int, view?: string)` | `int` | Read-Only | Reads `REG_DWORD` or `REG_QWORD` integer. |
| `reg.listSubkeys` | `reg.listSubkeys(hive: string, key: string, view?: string)` | `array` | Read-Only | Enumerates child subkey names as a `string[]` array (`RegView.Both` merges 64-bit & `WOW6432Node`!). |
| `reg.listValues` | `reg.listValues(hive: string, key: string, view?: string)` | `array` | Read-Only | Enumerates value names under `key` as a `string[]` array. |
| `reg.write` | `reg.write(hive: string, key: string, valueName: string, value: any, view?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Writes `REG_SZ` (for strings/paths) or `REG_DWORD` (for `int`/`bool`) with full prior-value rollback journaling. |
| `reg.writeString` | `reg.writeString(hive: string, key: string, valueName: string, value: string, view?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Writes `REG_SZ` UTF-16 string value (rollback-journaled). |
| `reg.writeExpandString` | `reg.writeExpandString(hive: string, key: string, valueName: string, value: string, view?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Writes `REG_EXPAND_SZ` unexpanded `%VAR%` string (rollback-journaled). |
| `reg.writeDword` | `reg.writeDword(hive: string, key: string, valueName: string, value: int, view?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Writes 32-bit `REG_DWORD` value (rollback-journaled). |
| `reg.appendMultiString` | `reg.appendMultiString(hive: string, key: string, valueName: string, item: string, view?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Idempotently appends `item` to a `REG_MULTI_SZ` list without duplicating existing entries. |
| `reg.deleteValue` | `reg.deleteValue(hive: string, key: string, valueName: string, view?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Deletes `valueName` (prior value saved in `.rsw-rollback.jnl` for automatic restoration on fault). |
| `reg.deleteKeyTree` | `reg.deleteKeyTree(hive: string, key: string, view?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Recursively deletes `key` (`RegDeleteTreeW`). |

```rssc
// Clean null-coalescing lookup across HKCU -> 64-bit HKLM -> Program Files fallback!
let hostDir = reg.read(Hive.HKCU, r"Software\RaggieSoft\Book Reader", "Install Path")
           ?? reg.read(Hive.HKLM, r"SOFTWARE\RaggieSoft\Book Reader", "Install Path", view: RegView.Native64)
           ?? (sys.programFiles / "RaggieSoft" / "Book Reader");
```

TOPIC: archive.*, crypto.*, net.* & log.* [ns-archive-crypto-net-log] (Windows, MSI SQL & Native FFI)
