# `archive.*`, `crypto.*`, `net.*` & `log.*` {#ns-archive-crypto-net-log}

## `archive.*` — Zero-Dependency Multi-Format Packaging & Extraction (`23` Methods) {#archive-namespace}

Every `archive.*` function in both **`raggiescript.exe` (static `/MT` Win32 C++20)** and **`RaggieScript.Core` (`.NET` v1.2)** runs against **100% EULA-clean, zero-dependency engines built straight into Windows 11 (`x64` & `ARM64`)**:

- **`System32\cabinet.dll` (`COMPRESS_ALGORITHM_LZMS`) + `bcrypt.dll` (`SHA-256`)**: Powers RaggieSoft's solid `.rswpak` (`RSWPAK1`) container in-process with 100% binary wire compatibility between C++20 and `.NET`.
- **`System32\tar.exe` (`bsdtar 3.8.9` / BSD `libarchive` + `zlib` + Public-Domain `liblzma 5.8.3` + `bz2lib` + `libzstd 1.5.7`)**: Powers `.zip` (plus `.nupkg`, `.vsix`, `.epub`, `.msix`), `.7z` (`LZMA` / `LZMA2` solid), `.tar` (`.tar.gz`, `.tar.bz2`, `.tar.xz`, `.tar.lzma`, `.tar.zst`), `.zst` (Zstandard bundles), `.iso` (`ISO 9660` Collector's Edition optical disc images for Showcase Studio), `.cpio`, and `.xar`.
- **`System32\makecab.exe` (`LZX:21` multi-folder `.ddf`)**: Builds genuine Windows `.cab` cabinets for `.msi` media and driver packages.
- **`System32\wimgapi.dll` (`WIMCreateFile` / `WIMCaptureImage` / `WIMApplyImage`)**: Captures and applies Windows `.wim` images when elevated (`Uac.Deferred` / `Uac.RequireAdministrator`), automatically enabling `SeBackupPrivilege` and `SeRestorePrivilege`.

> [!IMPORTANT] **Security, Transactional Rollback & EULA Guardrails**:
> 1. **Pre-Extraction Zip-Slip (`../`) Gate**: Every entry is audited *before* extraction; any `..` traversal segment, rooted path, or drive prefix aborts immediately before touching disk.
> 2. **Automatic `.rsw-rollback.jnl` Undo**: Every `archive.extract*` call unpacks into an isolated staging directory first and commits files through the LIFO rollback ledger—backing up overwritten destination files to `.rswbak`!
> 3. **Permanent `.rar` Exclusion**: Proprietary `.rar` archives (`Rar!` magic or `.rar` extension) are permanently rejected so RaggieScript never touches RARLAB/unRAR license restrictions.

### 1. Read-Only & Wizard-Safe Inspection (`2` Methods — Allowed Inside `wizard { ... }`) {#archive-readonly}

| Method | Signature | Return | Mutating? | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| `archive.list` | `archive.list(archiveFile: path)` | `array` | Wizard-Safe | Inspects any supported archive and returns `{ path: string, size: int, isDir: bool }[]` (rejecting Zip-Slip paths & `.rar`). |
| `archive.verify` | `archive.verify(archiveFile: path, expectedSha256?: string)` | `bool` | Wizard-Safe | Verifies optional 64-char hex `SHA-256`, container structure (including `RSWPAK1` inner `SHA-256`), and Zip-Slip path safety. |

### 2. Auto-Detecting & Format-Specific Packaging (`21` Mutating Methods — `RSW701` Gated) {#archive-mutating}

Every `archive.create*` call accepts a **source folder** (or single file), writes `outArchive`, and returns its **64-character lowercase `SHA-256` hex digest**. Every `archive.extract*` call verifies optional `expectedSha256` *before* unpacking and returns the **`int` count of extracted files**.

| Method | Signature | Return | Underlying Windows 11 Engine & Container |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `archive.create` | `archive.create(sourcePath: path, outArchive: path, options?: map)` | `string` (`SHA-256`) | Infers container format automatically from `outArchive` extension (`.zip`, `.7z`, `.rswpak`, `.cab`, `.tar.*`, `.zst`, `.iso`, `.wim`, `.cpio`, `.xar`). |
| `archive.extract` | `archive.extract(archiveFile: path, destDir: path, expectedSha256?: string)` | `int` (files) | Sniffs **magic header bytes** (`PK\x03\x04` `.zip`/`.nupkg`/`.vsix`/`.epub`, `7z\xBC\xAF` `.7z`, `RSWPAK1` `.rswpak`, `MSCF` `.cab`, `CD001` `.iso`, `MSWIM` `.wim`, `\x28\xB5\x2F\xFD` `.zst`, `070701` `.cpio`, `xar!`) and extracts with rollback tracking. |
| `archive.createZip` | `archive.createZip(sourcePath: path, outZip: path, options?: map)` | `string` (`SHA-256`) | Packs folder/file into standard `DEFLATE` `.zip`. |
| `archive.extractZip` | `archive.extractZip(zipFile: path, destDir: path, expectedSha256?: string)` | `int` (files) | Extracts `.zip` (or `.nupkg` / `.vsix` / `.epub`) into `destDir`. |
| `archive.create7z` | `archive.create7z(sourcePath: path, out7z: path, options?: map)` | `string` (`SHA-256`) | Packs folder/file into solid Public-Domain `LZMA2` `.7z` (`System32\tar.exe --format=7zip`). |
| `archive.extract7z` | `archive.extract7z(sevenZipFile: path, destDir: path, expectedSha256?: string)` | `int` (files) | Extracts `.7z` (`LZMA` / `LZMA2`) archive into `destDir`. |
| `archive.createLzma` | `archive.createLzma(sourcePath: path, out7z: path, options?: map)` | `string` (`SHA-256`) | Algorithm-named alias for `archive.create7z`. |
| `archive.extractLzma` | `archive.extractLzma(sevenZipFile: path, destDir: path, expectedSha256?: string)` | `int` (files) | Algorithm-named alias for `archive.extract7z`. |
| `archive.createPak` | `archive.createPak(sourcePath: path, outPakFile: path, options?: map)` | `string` (`SHA-256`) | Compresses folder/file into RaggieSoft's solid `LZMS` `.rswpak` (`RSWPAK1` + inner `SHA-256`). |
| `archive.extractPak` | `archive.extractPak(pakFile: path, destDir: path, expectedSha256?: string)` | `int` (files) | Verifies both outer and inner `RSWPAK1` `SHA-256` digests and extracts into `destDir`. |
| `archive.downloadPak` | `archive.downloadPak(httpsUrl: string, destDir: path, expectedSha256?: string, verifyAuthenticode?: bool)` | `int` (files) | Streams remote pack over TLS 1.2/1.3 `WinHTTP`, verifies `SHA-256` before unpacking, and extracts. |
| `archive.createCab` | `archive.createCab(sourcePath: path, outCab: path, options?: map)` | `string` (`SHA-256`) | Compresses folder hierarchy into a multi-folder `LZX:21` Windows `.cab` (`System32\makecab.exe`). |
| `archive.extractCab` | `archive.extractCab(cabFile: path, destDir: path, expectedSha256?: string)` | `int` (files) | Extracts a Windows `.cab` cabinet preserving subdirectory structure. |
| `archive.createTar` | `archive.createTar(sourcePath: path, outTar: path, options?: map)` | `string` (`SHA-256`) | Creates `.tar`, `.tar.gz`/`.tgz`, `.tar.bz2`, `.tar.xz`, `.tar.lzma`, or `.tar.zst` based on extension. |
| `archive.extractTar` | `archive.extractTar(tarFile: path, destDir: path, expectedSha256?: string)` | `int` (files) | Extracts any uncompressed or compressed POSIX tarball into `destDir`. |
| `archive.createZst` | `archive.createZst(sourcePath: path, outZst: path, options?: map)` | `string` (`SHA-256`) | Packs folder/file into a fast Zstandard `.tar.zst` bundle (`libzstd 1.5.7`). |
| `archive.extractZst` | `archive.extractZst(zstFile: path, destDir: path, expectedSha256?: string)` | `int` (files) | Extracts a Zstandard `.tar.zst` / `.tzst` bundle into `destDir`. |
| `archive.createIso` | `archive.createIso(sourcePath: path, outIso: path, options?: map)` | `string` (`SHA-256`) | Builds an `ISO 9660` (`.iso`) Collector's Edition optical disc image (`--format=iso9660`). |
| `archive.extractIso` | `archive.extractIso(isoFile: path, destDir: path, expectedSha256?: string)` | `int` (files) | Extracts an `ISO 9660` (`.iso`) optical image into `destDir` (normalizing writable file attributes). |
| `archive.createWim` | `archive.createWim(sourceDir: path, outWim: path, options?: map)` | `string` (`SHA-256`) | Captures `sourceDir` into a Windows `.wim` image via `System32\wimgapi.dll` (requires elevation). |
| `archive.extractWim` | `archive.extractWim(wimFile: path, destDir: path, expectedSha256?: string)` | `int` (files) | Applies image `#1` of a Windows `.wim` file via `System32\wimgapi.dll` (requires elevation). |

```csharp
use installer;

param payload7z: path = sys.supportDir / "StarlightAssets.7z";
param installDir: path = sys.programFiles / "Starlight";

wizard {
    step VerifyMedia {
        // archive.verify() and archive.list() are 100% read-only & allowed inside wizard {}!
        if (!archive.verify(payload7z)) {
            ui.notice("Collector media archive is missing or corrupted.");
        }
    }
}

install {
    // Automatically journaled in .rsw-rollback.jnl — rolled back cleanly if a later step fails!
    const extracted = archive.extract7z(payload7z, installDir / "Assets");
    const backupSha = archive.createZst(installDir / "Config", sys.localAppData / "Starlight" / "config-backup.tar.zst");
    log.info("Unpacked ${extracted} files; config snapshot SHA-256 = ${backupSha}");
}
```

## `crypto.*` — CNG `bcrypt.dll` Hashing, UUIDv5 & Authenticode (`7` Methods) {#crypto-namespace}

All `crypto.*` methods are **100% Read-Only & Wizard-Safe**, implemented directly against Windows `bcrypt.dll` and `wintrust.dll` with zero OpenSSL DLL dependencies:

| Method | Signature | Return | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `crypto.sha256` | `crypto.sha256(text: string)` | `string` | Computes lowercase 64-char hex SHA-256 of UTF-8 `text`. |
| `crypto.sha256Text` | `crypto.sha256Text(text: string)` | `string` | Explicit alias for `crypto.sha256(text)`. |
| `crypto.sha256File` | `crypto.sha256File(file: path)` | `string` | Streams `file` in 64 KB chunks through `BCRYPT_SHA256_ALGORITHM` and returns 64-char hex SHA-256. |
| `crypto.crc32Text` | `crypto.crc32Text(text: string)` | `int` | Computes unsigned IEEE 802.3 CRC-32 checksum of `text`. |
| `crypto.newGuid` | `crypto.newGuid()` | `string` | Generates a random uppercase `{GUID}` via `BCryptGenRandom`. |
| `crypto.uuid5` | `crypto.uuid5(name: string, namespaceGuid?: string)` | `string` | Generates deterministic RFC 4122 SHA-1 UUIDv5 `{GUID}` for reproducible MSI Component GUIDs. |
| `crypto.verifyAuthenticode` | `crypto.verifyAuthenticode(peFile: path)` | `bool` | Verifies Microsoft Authenticode / Azure Artifact Signing chain via `WinVerifyTrust`. |

## `net.*` — Native TLS 1.2 / 1.3 `WinHTTP` Client & Winsock2 TCP Port Probes (`6` Methods) {#net-namespace}

`net.*` pairs the OS-integrated `winhttp.dll` HTTPS stack with sub-millisecond Winsock2 local TCP port availability probes (`isPortFree` and `findFreePort`, both **Wizard-Safe** for `ui.textBox` port validators!) under `use installer;`:

| Method | Signature | Return | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `net.download` | `net.download(httpsUrl: string, destFile: path, expectedSha256?: string)` | `bool` | Downloads `httpsUrl` to `destFile` with live UI progress; deletes `destFile` and returns `false` if `expectedSha256` mismatches! |
| `net.getText` | `net.getText(httpsUrl: string)` | `string` | Performs an HTTPS `GET` and returns the UTF-8 response body. |
| `net.getJson` | `net.getJson(httpsUrl: string)` | `any` | Fetches and parses a remote HTTPS JSON manifest (`catalog.json`, release channels, etc.). |
| `net.probe` | `net.probe(httpsUrl: string)` | `bool` | Performs a fast 4-second `HEAD`/`GET` reachability probe (`true` on HTTP `200..299`). |
| `net.isPortFree` | `net.isPortFree(port: int, loopbackOnly?: bool)` | `bool` | **Wizard-Safe**: Probes via Winsock2 (`ws2_32.lib`) whether local TCP `port` (`1..65535`) is free to bind. |
| `net.findFreePort` | `net.findFreePort(startPort?: int, endPort?: int)` | `int` | **Wizard-Safe**: Returns the first available local TCP port in `[startPort, endPort]` (defaults `8000..9000`, or `-1`). |

# `proc.*`, `ffi.*`, `rm.*`, `shortcut.*`, `shell.*`, `env.*`, `arp.*`, `svc.*`, `task.*`, `firewall.*` & `acl.*` {#ns-proc-ffi-rm-system}

This chapter documents every Windows process, 64-bit native DLL FFI, Restart Manager, shell integration, environment `PATH`, *Installed apps* (`ARP`), Windows Service, Scheduled Task, Defender Firewall, and NTFS ACL API in RaggieScript v1.0.

## `proc.*` & `rm.*` — Process Execution, Explorer De-Elevation & Restart Manager (`14` Methods) {#proc-rm-namespaces}

> [!IMPORTANT] **Why `token: Token.Desktop` Matters on Finish Screens**: When an elevated `Setup.exe` (`High` integrity Admin token) launches a user desktop app directly via `CreateProcessW`, the app inherits the Admin token—breaking Windows Explorer drag-and-drop (`UIPI`) and writing `%LOCALAPPDATA%` configs owned by `Administrators`! Passing `token: Token.Desktop` duplicates the interactive `explorer.exe` shell's medium-integrity token (`CreateProcessWithTokenW`), launching the app cleanly as the signed-in desktop user!

| Method | Signature | Return | Mutating? | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `proc.isRunning` | `proc.isRunning(exeName: string)` | `bool` | Read-Only | Snapshots running processes (`CreateToolhelp32Snapshot`) to check if `exeName` is active. |
| `proc.listRunning` | `proc.listRunning(filterSubstr?: string)` | `array` | Read-Only | Returns array of `{ pid, name }` maps for active processes. |
| `proc.run` | `proc.run(exe: path, args?: string, wait?: bool, hidden?: bool, token?: string, workDir?: path, timeoutMs?: int)` | `int` | Host | Launches `exe` under `Token.Current`, `Token.Elevated`, or `Token.Desktop`; returns exit code when `wait: true` (or `0` when `wait: false`). |
| `proc.exec` | `proc.exec(exe: path, ...)` | `int` | Host | Alias for `proc.run(...)`. |
| `proc.open` | `proc.open(urlOrDoc: string, args?: string)` | `bool` | Host | Opens an `https://` URL, custom URI (`raggiesoft-books://...`), or document via `ShellExecuteExW`. |
| `proc.shellOpen` | `proc.shellOpen(urlOrDoc: string, args?: string)` | `bool` | Host | Alias for `proc.open(...)`. |
| `proc.terminate` | `proc.terminate(exeName: string, exitCode?: int)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Force-terminates matching processes (prefer `proc.restartManagerShutdown` first!). |
| `proc.callDllInt` | `proc.callDllInt(dllName: string, exportName: string, ...intArgs)` | `int` | Host | Calls a native 64-bit C ABI DLL export with integer arguments and returns `int64`. |
| `proc.getLockingProcesses` | `proc.getLockingProcesses(filePaths: array)` | `array` | Read-Only | Queries Windows Restart Manager (`Rstrtmgr.dll!RmGetList`) and returns `{ pid, appName, serviceShortName }[]` locking `filePaths`. |
| `proc.restartManagerShutdown` | `proc.restartManagerShutdown(filePaths: array, forceUnresponsive?: bool)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Gracefully closes applications/services holding locks on `filePaths` via `RmShutdown` (saving `WM_QUERYENDSESSION` state!). |
| `proc.restartManagerRestart` | `proc.restartManagerRestart()` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Restarts applications closed during the active Restart Manager session (`RmRestart`). |
| `rm.getLockingProcesses` | `rm.getLockingProcesses(filePaths: array)` | `array` | Read-Only | Clean alias for `proc.getLockingProcesses(filePaths)`. |
| `rm.shutdown` | `rm.shutdown(filePaths: array, force?: bool)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Clean alias for `proc.restartManagerShutdown(filePaths, force)`. |
| `rm.restart` | `rm.restart()` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Clean alias for `proc.restartManagerRestart()`. |

## `ffi.*` — Native 64-Bit DLL Foreign Function Interface (`1` Method) {#ffi-namespace}

`ffi.call` loads any native 64-bit (`x64` or `ARM64` matching host) DLL and marshals `int`/`uint`/`ptr`, UTF-8 `str`, and UTF-16 `wstr` arguments over the platform ABI (`Microsoft x64` or `AAPCS64` on ARM64):

| Method | Signature | Return | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ffi.call` | `ffi.call(dllName: string, funcName: string, returnType: string, args: array)` | `any` | `returnType`: `"int"`, `"uint"`, `"bool"`, `"ptr"`, `"str"`, `"wstr"`, or `"void"`. Strings inside `args` marshal automatically as wide UTF-16 pointers (`LPCWSTR`) when `funcName` ends with `'W'`, or UTF-8 (`LPCSTR`) otherwise! |

```rssc
const pid = ffi.call("kernel32.dll", "GetCurrentProcessId", "uint", []);
```

## `shortcut.*` & `shell.*` — `.lnk` Shortcuts, File Types & URI Protocols (`6` Methods) {#shortcut-shell-namespaces}

| Method | Signature | Return | Mutating? | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `shortcut.create` | `shortcut.create(location: any, name: string, target: path, args?: string, description?: string, iconPath?: path, workDir?: path)` | `path` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Creates a COM `IShellLinkW` `.lnk` file in `"Desktop"`, `"StartMenu"`, `"PublicDesktop"`, `"CommonStartMenu"`, or an explicit folder `path` (rollback-tracked!). |
| `shortcut.remove` | `shortcut.remove(lnkPath: path)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Removes a `.lnk` shortcut file. |
| `shell.registerFileType` | `shell.registerFileType(ext: string, progId: string, description: string, target: path, iconPath?: path, verbArgs?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Registers `.ext` + `ProgID` cleanly under `Software\Classes` (`HKCU` for `Scope.User`, `HKLM` for `Scope.Machine`—zero legacy pipe-delimited parsing bugs!). |
| `shell.unregisterFileType` | `shell.unregisterFileType(ext: string, progId: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Removes `.ext` and `ProgID` registration keys. |
| `shell.registerProtocol` | `shell.registerProtocol(scheme: string, description: string, targetExe: path)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Registers a custom `scheme://` URL protocol (`URL Protocol = ""`, `shell\open\command`). |
| `shell.refresh` | `shell.refresh()` | `bool` | Safe Notify | Broadcasts `SHChangeNotify(SHCNE_ASSOCCHANGED, SHCNF_IDLIST)` so Explorer icons update immediately. |

## `env.*` & `arp.*` — Non-Clobbering `PATH` & Windows *Installed Apps* (`7` Methods) {#env-arp-namespaces}

| Method | Signature | Return | Mutating? | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `env.get` | `env.get(name: string, scope?: string)` | `string` | Read-Only | Reads process, `"user"`, or `"machine"` environment variable. |
| `env.set` | `env.set(name: string, value: string, scope?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Writes `"user"` or `"machine"` environment variable and broadcasts `WM_SETTINGCHANGE("Environment")` with timeout (`SendMessageTimeoutW`). |
| `env.remove` | `env.remove(name: string, scope?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Deletes environment variable (restored on rollback). |
| `env.appendPath` | `env.appendPath(dirToAdd: path, scope?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Reads raw `REG_EXPAND_SZ` `Path`, checks case-insensitively if `dirToAdd` is already present, appends **only** the new segment (preserving `%SystemRoot%`!), and records surgical single-entry removal for uninstall/rollback! |
| `arp.register` | `arp.register(options?: map)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Writes `CurrentVersion\Uninstall\<id>`, generates `<installDir>\Uninstall.exe` + `Uninstall.rswm`, and computes `EstimatedSize` KB. |
| `arp.setSystemComponent` | `arp.setSystemComponent(productId: string, hidden: bool, scope?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Sets `SystemComponent = 1` (adopted by a Suite) or `0` (standalone visible in *Installed apps*). |
| `arp.unregister` | `arp.unregister(productId: string, scope?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Removes the `CurrentVersion\Uninstall\<productId>` entry. |

## `svc.*`, `task.*`, `firewall.*` & `acl.*` — Services, Tasks, Firewall & NTFS ACLs (`13` Methods) {#svc-task-fw-acl}

| Method | Signature | Return | Mutating? | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `svc.exists` | `svc.exists(serviceName: string)` | `bool` | Read-Only | Checks SCM (`OpenServiceW`) for `serviceName`. |
| `svc.status` | `svc.status(serviceName: string)` | `string` | Read-Only | Returns `"running"`, `"stopped"`, `"paused"`, or `"missing"`. |
| `svc.install` | `svc.install(serviceName: string, binPath: path, displayName?: string, startType?: string, description?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Creates or updates a Win32 Service (`CreateServiceW`, rolled back automatically on install failure). |
| `svc.configureFailureReset` | `svc.configureFailureReset(serviceName: string, restartDelayMs?: int, resetPeriodSec?: int)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Configures `SERVICE_CONFIG_FAILURE_ACTIONS` automatic recovery restart. |
| `svc.start` | `svc.start(serviceName: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Starts `serviceName` and waits for `SERVICE_RUNNING`. |
| `svc.stop` | `svc.stop(serviceName: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Sends `SERVICE_CONTROL_STOP` and waits cleanly. |
| `svc.remove` | `svc.remove(serviceName: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Stops and deletes `serviceName` (`DeleteService`). |
| `task.exists` | `task.exists(taskName: string)` | `bool` | Read-Only | Checks Windows Task Scheduler for `taskName`. |
| `task.createWeekly` | `task.createWeekly(taskName: string, exePath: path, args?: string, dayOfWeek?: string, startTime?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Registers an opt-in weekly Scheduled Task (rollback-tracked). |
| `task.remove` | `task.remove(taskName: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Deletes Scheduled Task `taskName`. |
| `firewall.allowProgram` | `firewall.allowProgram(ruleName: string, exePath: path, direction?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Adds a Windows Defender Firewall program rule via COM `INetFwPolicy2` (removed automatically on rollback/uninstall). |
| `firewall.removeRule` | `firewall.removeRule(ruleName: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Removes Defender Firewall rule `ruleName`. |
| `acl.grantModify` | `acl.grantModify(targetDir: path, trusteeSidOrWellKnown?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Grants NTFS `FILE_GENERIC_MODIFY` (`OI|CI`) via `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` (defaults to `"Users"` / `S-1-5-32-545`). |

## `com.*`, `font.*`, `sign.*`, `cert.*`, `mutex.*` & `activesetup.*` — v1.3 Windows Packaging Power Tools (`16` Methods) {#com-font-cert-mutex-activesetup}

> [!TIP] **Zero-`HKCR` Reg-Free COM Isolation for Classic VB6 & ActiveX Apps**: Instead of polluting global `HKCR\CLSID` keys (which causes "DLL Hell" across side-by-side versions of classic Visual Basic 6.0 / `.ocx` utilities like early *StoreTrainer*), `com.generateRegFreeManifest` inspects each `.dll`/`.ocx` via `oleaut32.dll!LoadTypeLibEx(..., REGKIND_NONE)` and emits a deterministic Windows Side-by-Side `.exe.manifest` XML file!

| Method | Signature | Return | Mutating? | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `com.inspectTypeLib` | `com.inspectTypeLib(dllOrOcx: path)` | `map` | Wizard-Safe | Reads COM `ITypeLib` metadata via `REGKIND_NONE` (`{ found, libId, version, libraryName, coclasses }`) without touching the Registry. |
| `com.generateRegFreeManifest` | `com.generateRegFreeManifest(exePath: path, comFiles: array, outManifest: path)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Generates a Side-by-Side `.exe.manifest` (`<file>`, `<typelib>`, `<comClass>`) for zero-Registry ActiveX/VB6 isolation (rollback-tracked). |
| `com.registerInproc` | `com.registerInproc(dllOrOcx: path)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Invokes `DllRegisterServer` on an in-process COM server when global registration is explicitly required. |
| `com.unregisterInproc` | `com.unregisterInproc(dllOrOcx: path)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Invokes `DllUnregisterServer` on an in-process COM server. |
| `font.isInstalled` | `font.isInstalled(fontFileName: path, scope?: string)` | `bool` | Wizard-Safe | Checks `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Fonts` (`"user"`) or `C:\Windows\Fonts` (`"machine"`). |
| `font.install` | `font.install(fontFile: path, scope?: string, displayName?: string)` | `path` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Copies `.ttf`/`.otf`, registers `CurrentVersion\Fonts`, calls `AddFontResourceExW`, and broadcasts `WM_FONTCHANGE` with zero reboot! |
| `font.uninstall` | `font.uninstall(fontFileName: path, scope?: string, displayName?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Calls `RemoveFontResourceExW`, deletes font entry, and broadcasts `WM_FONTCHANGE`. |
| `sign.inspect` | `sign.inspect(peFile: path)` | `map` | Wizard-Safe | Extracts X.509 / PKCS#7 Authenticode details via `crypt32.dll` (`{ signed, trusted, subject, issuer, thumbprintSha1 }`). |
| `cert.isInstalled` | `cert.isInstalled(thumbprintSha1: string, store?: string, scope?: string)` | `bool` | Wizard-Safe | Checks `CertStore.TrustedPublisher` / `CertStore.Root` for a matching SHA-1 certificate thumbprint. |
| `cert.importTrustedPublisher` | `cert.importTrustedPublisher(cerFile: path, scope?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Imports a DER or Base64 PEM `.cer` certificate into `TrustedPublisher`. |
| `cert.remove` | `cert.remove(thumbprintSha1: string, store?: string, scope?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Deletes a certificate by SHA-1 thumbprint from the target Windows certificate store. |
| `mutex.isHeld` | `mutex.isHeld(mutexName: string)` | `bool` | Wizard-Safe | Probes `OpenMutexW(SYNCHRONIZE)` for `"Global\\..."` or `"Local\\..."` single-instance application locks. |
| `mutex.waitRelease` | `mutex.waitRelease(mutexName: string, timeoutMs?: int)` | `bool` | Wizard-Safe | Waits up to `timeoutMs` (default `5000`) for a running application mutex to close cleanly. |
| `activesetup.isRegistered` | `activesetup.isRegistered(componentId: string)` | `bool` | Wizard-Safe | Checks `Active Setup\Installed Components\<componentId>`. |
| `activesetup.register` | `activesetup.register(id: string, stubPath: string, version?: string, title?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Registers per-machine Active Setup `StubPath` so every Windows user profile hydrates per-user settings on next sign-in! |
| `activesetup.unregister` | `activesetup.unregister(componentId: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Removes Active Setup `Installed Components` registration. |


================================================================================
TOPIC: msi.* & prereq.* — 64-Bit MSI SQL, .MST & Runtimes [ns-msi-and-prereq] (Windows, MSI SQL & Native FFI)
================================================================================

# `msi.*` & `prereq.*` — Direct 64-Bit MSI SQL Engine, `.MST` Transforms & Runtime Presets {#ns-msi-and-prereq}

RaggieScript gives you **both** worlds: you can write pure zero-MSI native installers (where `Error 1618` mutex contention is impossible), **or** you can drive and author Windows Installer `.msi`, `.msm`, `.mst`, and `.msp` relational SQL databases directly in native 64-bit (`x64` / `ARM64`) via `msi.*`!

## `msi.*` — Product Discovery & External-UI Execution (`10` Methods) {#msi-runtime}

| Method | Signature | Return | Mutating? | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `msi.isUpgradeInstalled` | `msi.isUpgradeInstalled(upgradeCodeGuid: string)` | `map` | Read-Only | Calls `MsiEnumRelatedProductsW` and returns `{ installed: bool, productCode: string, version: version, installLocation: path }`. |
| `msi.isProductInstalled` | `msi.isProductInstalled(productCodeGuid: string)` | `bool` | Read-Only | Calls `MsiQueryProductStateW` (`INSTALLSTATE_DEFAULT`). |
| `msi.isNativeInstalled` | `msi.isNativeInstalled(packageId: string, scope?: string)` | `bool` | Read-Only | Checks `CurrentVersion\Uninstall\<packageId>` for a native RaggieScript package. |
| `msi.findRelatedProducts` | `msi.findRelatedProducts(upgradeCodeGuid: string)` | `array` | Read-Only | Returns `string[]` of all installed `ProductCode` GUIDs sharing `upgradeCodeGuid`. |
| `msi.install` | `msi.install(msiPath: path, properties?: map, silent?: bool, logFile?: path)` | `int` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Installs `msiPath` via `MsiInstallProductW` with live `MsiSetExternalUIRecord` progress forwarded into your RaggieScript wizard bar; returns Win32 MSI code (`0`, `3010`, `1602`, `1603`, etc.). |
| `msi.repair` | `msi.repair(productCodeOrMsi: string, reinstallFlags?: string, logFile?: path)` | `int` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Repairs an installed MSI (`REINSTALLMODE_PECMS` default). |
| `msi.uninstall` | `msi.uninstall(productCodeGuid: string, extraProps?: string, logFile?: path)` | `int` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Uninstalls `productCodeGuid` (`REMOVE=ALL`). |
| `msi.applyPatch` | `msi.applyPatch(mspPath: path, targetProductCode?: string, commandLine?: string)` | `int` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Applies a binary-delta `.msp` Windows Installer patch (`MsiApplyPatchW`). |
| `msi.configureFeature` | `msi.configureFeature(productCodeGuid: string, featureId: string, installState?: string)` | `int` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Sets an individual MSI feature to `"local"`, `"absent"`, or `"source"`. |
| `msi.runLegacyUninstaller` | `msi.runLegacyUninstaller(productIdOrUpgradeCode: string, preferQuiet?: bool, extraArgs?: string)` | `int` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Discovers and runs an existing `QuietUninstallString` / `UninstallString` before upgrading a legacy installer! |

## `msi.*` — Direct 64-Bit Relational MSI SQL Table & `.MST` Transform Engine (`11` Methods) {#msi-sql}

Every SQL operation opens `msi.dll` handles cleanly with RAII scope guards (`MsiOpenDatabaseW` -> `MsiDatabaseOpenViewW` -> `MsiViewExecute` -> `MsiDatabaseCommit`), supporting Schema `500` (`x64;1033` and `Arm64;1033`) with zero 32-bit `orca.exe` limits:

| Method | Signature | Return | Mutating? | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `msi.createDatabase` | `msi.createDatabase(msiPath: path)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Creates a brand-new empty `.msi` OLE structured-storage database (`MSIDBOPEN_CREATEDIRECT`). |
| `msi.listTables` | `msi.listTables(msiPath: path)` | `array` | Read-Only | Queries `_Tables` and returns `string[]` of all persistent tables in `msiPath`. |
| `msi.query` | `msi.query(msiPath: path, selectSql: string)` | `array` | Read-Only | Executes an MSI SQL `SELECT` query and returns `map[]` rows keyed by column name! |
| `msi.execSql` | `msi.execSql(msiPath: path, sqlOrBatchArray: any)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Executes a single MSI SQL DDL/DML string (`CREATE TABLE`, `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE`, `ALTER TABLE`) **or** an atomic `string[]` batch committed together! |
| `msi.getProperty` | `msi.getProperty(msiPath: path, propName: string, fallback?: string)` | `string` | Read-Only | Reads `Value` for `propName` from the MSI `Property` table. |
| `msi.setProperty` | `msi.setProperty(msiPath: path, propName: string, value: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Creates the `Property` table if needed and upserts `(propName, value)` safely via parameterized `MsiRecordSetStringW`. |
| `msi.getSummary` | `msi.getSummary(msiPath: path)` | `map` | Read-Only | Reads OLE `\005SummaryInformation` stream (`title`, `subject`, `author`, `comments`, `template`, `packageCode`, `schema`, `wordCount`). |
| `msi.setSummary` | `msi.setSummary(msiPath: path, summaryMapOrPid: any, singleVal?: any)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Stamps OLE `SummaryInformation` properties (`template: "Arm64;1033"`, `schema: 500`, `wordCount: 2`, etc.). |
| `msi.importStream` | `msi.importStream(msiPath: path, tableName: string, rowName: string, sourceFile: path)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Streams a binary file (`MsiRecordSetStreamW`) into `Binary` or `Icon` table. |
| `msi.exportStream` | `msi.exportStream(msiPath: path, tableName: string, rowName: string, destFile: path)` | `bool` | Read-Only | Extracts a binary stream column from `Binary` / `Icon` / `_Streams` to `destFile`. |
| `msi.generateTransform` | `msi.generateTransform(baselineMsi: path, customizedMsi: path, outMstPath: path)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Computes a differential `.mst` GPO transform (`MsiDatabaseGenerateTransformW` + `MsiCreateTransformSummaryInfoW`)! |

```rssc
use installer;

let db = fs.tempDir("msi-demo") / "Sample.msi";
msi.createDatabase(db);
msi.setSummary(db, {
    title:    "Installation Database",
    template: sys.isArm64() ? "Arm64;1033" : "x64;1033",
    schema:   500
});
msi.setProperty(db, "Manufacturer", "RaggieSoft");
msi.execSql(db, [
    "CREATE TABLE `CustomPolicy` (`Key` CHAR(64) NOT NULL, `Value` CHAR(128) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY `Key`)",
    "INSERT INTO `CustomPolicy` (`Key`, `Value`) VALUES ('Telemetry', 'Disabled')"
]);
const rows = msi.query(db, "SELECT `Key`, `Value` FROM `CustomPolicy`");
assert(rows[0].Value == "Disabled");
```

## `prereq.*` — Curated `.NET` 8–11, WebView2 & VC++ Runtime Detection (`7` Methods) {#prereq-namespace}

All `prereq.*` detectors automatically check **true host silicon** (`ARM64` vs. `x64`) so an ARM64 Windows 11 laptop never gets mis-detected against an x64-only runtime:

| Method | Signature | Return | Mutating? | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `prereq.isDotNetDesktopInstalled` | `prereq.isDotNetDesktopInstalled(majorVer?: int, minVersion?: version)` | `bool` | Read-Only | Detects `Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App` (`8`, `9`, `10`, or `11`, default `10`) under `dotnet\shared`. |
| `prereq.isAspNetInstalled` | `prereq.isAspNetInstalled(majorVer?: int, minVersion?: version)` | `bool` | Read-Only | Detects `Microsoft.AspNetCore.App` (`8`..`11`). |
| `prereq.isDotNetRuntimeInstalled` | `prereq.isDotNetRuntimeInstalled(majorVer?: int, minVersion?: version)` | `bool` | Read-Only | Detects base `Microsoft.NETCore.App` (`8`..`11`). |
| `prereq.isWebView2Installed` | `prereq.isWebView2Installed()` | `bool` | Read-Only | Detects Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen Runtime across machine & per-user `Clients` keys. |
| `prereq.isVcRedist2022Installed` | `prereq.isVcRedist2022Installed(archOverride?: string)` | `bool` | Read-Only | Detects Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable (`14.30+`) for `arm64` or `x64`. |
| `prereq.isSatisfied` | `prereq.isSatisfied(presetId: string, arch?: string)` | `bool` | Read-Only | Checks curated preset IDs: `"DotNet8Desktop"`..`"DotNet11Desktop"`, `"DotNet10Runtime"`, `"DotNet11Runtime"`, `"WebView2"`, `"VcRedist2022"`. |
| `prereq.installPreset` | `prereq.installPreset(presetId: string, extraSilentArgs?: string)` | `bool` | **Mutating (`RSW701`)** | Extracts bundled or downloads official Microsoft HTTPS bootstrapper, verifies Authenticode, runs silently, and latches `3010` if reboot is requested! |


================================================================================
TOPIC: ui.*, wizard.* & showcase.* — Declarative Win32 Wizard UI [ns-ui-and-wizard] (Wizard UI & Studio Sandboxes)
================================================================================

# `ui.*`, `wizard.*` & `showcase.*` — Declarative Win32 Wizard UI, TaskDialogs & Canvas {#ns-ui-and-wizard}

RaggieScript v1.0 ships **two complementary native Win32 UI layers**—both Per-Monitor V2 DPI aware, Dark/Light Mode adaptive, Windows Contrast Theme (`SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST`) compliant, and 100% UI Automation screen-reader accessible:

1. **14 Declarative In-Window Wizard Controls (`ui.welcome` .. `ui.readySummary`)** rendered inside a single continuous wizard window (`RsscWizardUiEngine.hpp`) across all **11 `WizardStyle` themes**.
2. **Modal Windows 11 `TaskDialogIndirect` & Modern `IFileOpenDialog` Prompts (`ui.taskDialog`, `ui.pickFolder`, etc.)** for one-step micro-installers and standalone utilities.

## Declarative In-Window Wizard Controls (`14` Controls) {#declarative-wizard-controls}

Inside `wizard { step <StepId> when (<expr>) { ... } }`, controls stack cleanly in keyboard tab order with automatic `&` accelerator mnemonics, two-way `bind: ref <param>` synchronization, reactive `when: () => <bool>` dynamic enablement/visibility, and inline `validate: (val) => Validation.ok() | Validation.error("...")` gating:

| Control | Signature & Named Arguments | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ui.welcome` | `ui.welcome(title: string, subtitle?: string, body?: string, badge?: string)` | Hero welcome header, subtitle, and introductory copy for the opening step. |
| `ui.license` | `ui.license(text?: string, file?: path, acceptText?: string, bind: ref boolVar)` | Read-only scrollable RichEdit/Edit license pane + acceptance checkbox that gates **Next >** until checked! |
| `ui.readme` | `ui.readme(title: string, text?: string, file?: path)` | Scrollable release notes, liner notes, or story introduction card. |
| `ui.heading` | `ui.heading(text: string, subtitle?: string)` | Section divider heading inside a multi-control step. |
| `ui.label` | `ui.label(text: string, muted?: bool, when?: fn)` | Dynamic word-wrapped text label (re-evaluated live when `when:` is supplied). |
| `ui.notice` | `ui.notice(title: string, body?: string, icon?: string)` | Accessible in-window callout banner (`Icon.Info`, `Icon.Warning`, `Icon.Error`, `Icon.Shield`) replacing modal `MessageBox` popups! |
| `ui.folderPicker` | `ui.folderPicker(label: string, bind: ref pathVar, minFreeMB?: int, when?: fn, validate?: fn)` | Destination path `EDIT` + `Browse...` (`IFileOpenDialog(FOS_PICKFOLDERS)`) + live volume free-space MB indicator & `minFreeMB` gate! |
| `ui.filePicker` | `ui.filePicker(label: string, bind: ref pathVar, filter?: string, when?: fn, validate?: fn)` | Existing file `EDIT` + `Browse...` button. |
| `ui.textBox` | `ui.textBox(label: string, bind: ref strVar, placeholder?: string, password?: bool, when?: fn, validate?: fn)` | Single-line text or `ES_PASSWORD` input with live inline validation error banner. |
| `ui.checkbox` | `ui.checkbox(text: string, bind: ref boolVar, subtitle?: string, when?: fn)` | Two-way `BS_AUTOCHECKBOX` that immediately re-evaluates sibling `when:` closures on click/Spacebar! |
| `ui.radioCards` | `ui.radioCards(label: string, bind: ref strVar, options: array, when?: fn)` | Keyboard-navigable radio option cards (`options: [{ value, title, subtitle }]`). |
| `ui.comboBox` | `ui.comboBox(label: string, bind: ref enumOrStrVar, items: array, when?: fn)` | Dark/Light themed `CBS_DROPDOWNLIST` selector binding cleanly to `string` or string-backed `enum` parameters. |
| `ui.featureTree` | `ui.featureTree(heading?: string, showSizes?: bool, when?: fn)` | Interactive feature checklist bound 1:1 to top-level `feature` declarations (`required: true` items locked checked). |
| `ui.readySummary` | `ui.readySummary(heading?: string, installButton?: string, showUacShield?: bool, notes?: string)` | Displays selected destination, setup mode, and checked features, and stamps `BCM_SETSHIELD` on **&Install** when `showUacShield` is `true`! |

```rssc
param enableProxy: bool   = false;
param proxyPort:   string = "8080";

const checkPort = (raw: string) => {
    const p = int(str.trim(raw));
    return (p >= 1024 && p <= 65535)
        ? Validation.ok()
        : Validation.error("Enter a TCP port between 1024 and 65535.");
};

wizard {
    step Network {
        ui.checkbox(text: "Route updates through a local &proxy", bind: ref enableProxy);
        ui.textBox(
            label:    "Local proxy &port:",
            bind:     ref proxyPort,
            when:     () => enableProxy,
            validate: checkPort
        );
    }
}
```

| `ui.warn` | `ui.warn(heading: string, body?: string, title?: string, details?: string)` | `int` | Accessible warning `TaskDialogIndirect`. |
| `ui.error` | `ui.error(heading: string, body?: string, title?: string, details?: string)` | `int` | Accessible error `TaskDialogIndirect`. |
| `ui.abort` | `ui.abort(heading: string, body?: string)` | `null` | Displays accessible error dialog (unless `/s` silent) and aborts execution cleanly (`1603`). |
| `ui.confirm` | `ui.confirm(heading: string, body?: string, yesText?: string, noText?: string)` | `bool` | Accessible Yes/Cancel confirmation returning `true` when confirmed. |
| `ui.taskDialog` | `ui.taskDialog(title?: string, heading: string, body?: string, icon?: string, buttons?: array, verifyText?: string, detailsTitle?: string, detailsBody?: string, choice?: ref intVar, verifiedOut?: ref boolVar)` | `map` | Full Windows 11 Command-Link `TaskDialogIndirect` returning `{ button: int, verified: bool }` and writing `ref` out-parameters! |

## `wizard.*` & `showcase.*` — Wizard Navigation & Showcase Studio Canvas (`15` Methods) {#wizard-showcase-namespaces}

| Method | Signature | Return | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| `wizard.cancel` | `wizard.cancel(exitCode?: int)` | `null` | Cancels setup cleanly with standard user-exit code `1602` (`ERROR_INSTALL_USEREXIT`). |
| `showcase.navigate` | `showcase.navigate(pageId: string)` | `string` | Switches the active **RaggieSoft Showcase Studio** canvas page (`"Main"`, `"LinerNotes"`, `"ProgressPage"`). |

| `showcase.setHotspotBadge` | `showcase.setHotspotBadge(hotspotId: string, badgeText: string)` | `bool` | Updates dynamic hotspot badge/caption (e.g., toggling `"&Install"` <-> `"&Launch"`). |
| `showcase.setHotspotVisible` | `showcase.setHotspotVisible(hotspotId: string, visible: bool)` | `bool` | Shows or hides a canvas hotspot cleanly without leaving dead keyboard tab stops. |
| `showcase.setHotspotLabel` | `showcase.setHotspotLabel(hotspotId: string, labelText: string)` | `bool` | Updates both the rendered caption and UI Automation `Name` property of a hotspot. |
| `showcase.setHotspotTooltip` | `showcase.setHotspotTooltip(hotspotId: string, tooltipText: string)` | `bool` | Updates keyboard-focus and mouse-hover descriptive help text on a hotspot. |
| `showcase.focusHotspot` | `showcase.focusHotspot(hotspotId: string)` | `bool` | Moves deterministic keyboard & UIA focus to `hotspotId` after a dialog or install completes. |
| `showcase.openBooklet` | `showcase.openBooklet(docRelPath: string, page?: int)` | `bool` | Opens Showcase Studio's accessible collector liner-notes / booklet reader at optional `page`. |
| `showcase.openGallery` | `showcase.openGallery(galleryId: string, initialIndex?: int)` | `bool` | Opens high-DPI collector artwork gallery lightbox with full alt-text narration. |
| `showcase.announceSr` | `showcase.announceSr(message: string, assertive?: bool)` | `bool` | Broadcasts a polite UI Automation screen-reader live-region announcement (`UiaRaiseNotificationEvent`). |
| `showcase.playAudio` | `showcase.playAudio(trackRelPath: string, captionVttPath?: string)` | `bool` | Plays captioned Showcase background audio **only** after explicit user unmute (never autoplays per WCAG 1.4.2). |
| `showcase.stopAudio` | `showcase.stopAudio()` | `bool` | Stops Showcase audio playback cleanly. |

## All `11` Built-In `WizardStyle` Themes {#wizard-styles}

1. `WizardStyle.FluentMica` (`"fluentmica"`) — Windows 11 rounded card + DWM Mica/Dark titlebar.
2. `WizardStyle.AeroWizard` (`"aerowizard"`) — Windows Vista/7/10 command-header Aero Wizard.
3. `WizardStyle.Standard` (`"standard"`) — Clean classic two-pane enterprise installer.
4. `WizardStyle.Wizard97` (`"wizard97"`) — Classic white header banner + etched divider (`Wizard 97`).
5. `WizardStyle.Wizard95` (`"wizard95"`) — Authentic beveled 3D 1995 setup dialog with WCAG contrast protection.
6. `WizardStyle.FullScreenBlue` (`"fullscreenblue"`) — Classic 1990s cobalt gradient full-screen backdrop + centered wizard.
7. `WizardStyle.FullScreenTeal` (`"fullscreenteal"`) — Classic `#008080` desktop teal workstation setup backdrop.
8. `WizardStyle.Autorun16x9` (`"autorun16x9"`) — Widescreen `16:9` media/book/album collector edition card.
9. `WizardStyle.OneClick` (`"oneclick"`) — Streamlined single-card express installer.
10. `WizardStyle.PassiveToast` (`"passivetoast"`) — Compact corner/centered progress card without modal interruption.
11. `WizardStyle.Simple` (`"simple"`) — Minimal lightweight utility dialog.


================================================================================
TOPIC: Studio Profiles (training.*, a11y.*, localization.*, document.*, launcher.*, help.*) [studio-sandbox-profiles] (Wizard UI & Studio Sandboxes)
================================================================================

# Studio Sandbox Profiles (`training.*`, `a11y.*`, `localization.*`, `document.*`, `launcher.*`, `help.*`) {#studio-sandbox-profiles}

Because RaggieScript powers **all eight RaggieSoft Studio tools**, scripts authored for compliance, e-learning, localization, PDF generation, or help routing run inside **strict compile-time capability sandboxes (`RSW702`)**.

> [!IMPORTANT] **Zero Host Escape Guarantee (`RSW702`)**: Whenever a script declares `use training;`, `use a11y;`, `use localization;`, `use document;`, `use storescript;`, or `use crossroads;` (without `use installer;`), the RaggieScript static binder rejects **at compile time** any call to `fs.*`, `reg.*`, `proc.*`, `ffi.*`, `rm.*`, `svc.*`, `net.*`, `msi.*`, `prereq.*`, `shortcut.*`, `shell.*`, `firewall.*`, `acl.*`, `task.*`, `env.*`, `arp.*`, `ini.*`, `archive.*`, `com.*`, `font.*`, `cert.*`, `sign.*`, `mutex.*`, or `activesetup.*`. *(For consumer profiles `storescript.*` and `crossroads.*`, see [StoreScript & Story Crossroads](storescript-and-crossroads.html).)*

## `training.*` — RaggieSoft Training Studio SCORM 1.2 & 2004 (`9` Methods) {#training-namespace}

Compiles via `raggiescript.exe transpile-es2022` into a pure, zero-`eval()` ES2022 JavaScript module (`createRaggieScriptModule(host)`) for `< 50 KB` bandwidth-resilient SCORM courses, and also executes natively in the C++20 and `.NET` VMs for headless rubric testing!

| Method | Signature | Return | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `training.setScore` | `training.setScore(scorePct: int, maxScore?: int)` | `bool` | Records normalized quiz score (`0..100`, `cmi.core.score.raw` / `cmi.score.scaled`). |
| `training.completeSlide` | `training.completeSlide(slideId: string)` | `bool` | Marks `slideId` complete in Training Studio's offline Write-Ahead Queue (`WAL`). |
| `training.branchTo` | `training.branchTo(targetSlideId: string)` | `string` | Routes the learner to an adaptive scenario or remediation slide and returns `targetSlideId`. |
| `training.recordObjective` | `training.recordObjective(objectiveId: string, status: string, score?: int)` | `bool` | Records SCORM 2004 4th Edition `cmi.objectives.n` (`"passed"` / `"failed"` / `"completed"`). |
| `training.getState` | `training.getState(key: string, fallback?: any)` | `any` | Reads persisted `cmi.suspend_data` scenario variable (`<= 4,096` byte SCORM 1.2 safe). |
| `training.setState` | `training.setState(key: string, value: any)` | `bool` | Writes persisted `cmi.suspend_data` scenario state across LMS sessions. |
| `training.recordInteraction` | `training.recordInteraction(id: string, kind: string, learnerResponse: string, result?: string, latencySec?: float)` | `bool` | Appends a structured SCORM `cmi.interactions.n` item-analysis record. |
| `training.announcePolite` | `training.announcePolite(message: string)` | `bool` | Emits a polite `aria-live="polite"` feedback announcement for screen-reader learners. |
| `training.unlockNextSlide` | `training.unlockNextSlide(slideId?: string)` | `bool` | Unlocks the gated **Next** button after interactive scenario requirements are met. |

```rssc
use training;

enum Outcome {
    Certify   = "slide-certificate",
    Remediate = "slide-review"
}

fn gradeAssessment(points: int, maxPoints: int) : string {
    const pct = (points * 100) / maxPoints;
    training.setScore(pct);
    training.recordObjective("OBJ-ADA-2026", pct >= 80 ? "passed" : "failed", pct);
    training.completeSlide("slide-quiz");
    return training.branchTo(match (pct >= 80) {
        true  => Outcome.Certify,
        false => Outcome.Remediate
    });
}
```

## `a11y.*` — RaggieSoft Accessibility Studio Custom Compliance Rules (`7` Methods) {#a11y-namespace}

Executed inside `AccessibilityStudio.exe` and `a11y-studio-cli` via our managed `.NET` `RaggieScript.Core` SDK (and C++20 VM) to enforce organization-specific WCAG 2.2 AA & Section 508 design-system rules outputting OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 and Monaco Guided Fix diffs:

| Method | Signature | Return | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `a11y.contrastRatio` | `a11y.contrastRatio(fgHex: string, bgHex: string)` | `float` | Computes exact W3C WCAG 2.2 relative luminance contrast ratio (`1.0` .. `21.0`) between two `#RRGGBB` colors. |
| `a11y.reportViolation` | `a11y.reportViolation(ruleId: string, targetId: string, message: string, severity?: string, line?: int)` | `null` | Appends a structured SARIF 2.1.0 / VPAT diagnostic finding. |
| `a11y.suggestFix` | `a11y.suggestFix(ruleId: string, title: string, beforeSnippet: string, afterSnippet: string, explanation?: string)` | `map` | Registers a side-by-side Guided Fix diff preview inside Accessibility Studio's Monaco editor. |
| `a11y.queryHtml` | `a11y.queryHtml(markup: string, tagOrAttrSelector: string)` | `array` | Queries HTML/XAML markup for matching elements (`"img"`, `"[aria-hidden]"`, `"*"`) returning `{ tag, attrs, outer }[]`. |
| `a11y.parseVttCues` | `a11y.parseVttCues(vttText: string)` | `array` | Parses WebVTT captions into `{ index, startSec, endSec, text, cps, lineCount }[]` maps. |
| `a11y.hasAccessibleName` | `a11y.hasAccessibleName(elementMarkup: string)` | `bool` | Checks whether an element snippet exposes `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, or `alt`. |
| `a11y.isTouchTargetCompliant` | `a11y.isTouchTargetCompliant(widthPx: float, heightPx: float, minPx?: float)` | `bool` | Verifies WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (`>= 24x24` CSS px default, or `minPx: 44` for mobile bars). |

| Method | Signature | Return | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

================================================================================
TOPIC: StoreScript (StoreTrainer) & Story Crossroads Interactive Fiction [storescript-and-crossroads] (Wizard UI & Studio Sandboxes)
================================================================================

# `storescript.*` (StoreTrainer) & `crossroads.*` (Story Crossroads) {#storescript-and-crossroads}

RaggieScript v1.3 brings first-class, `RSW702` capability-sandboxed domain profiles to two flagship RaggieSoft consumer experiences: **StoreScript (`use storescript;`)** for **RaggieSoft StoreTrainer**, and **Story Crossroads (`use crossroads;`)** for interactive branching novels in **RaggieSoft Book Reader** and **`https://crossroads.raggiesoft.com`**.

> [!IMPORTANT] **Zero OS Escape Guarantee (`RSW702`)**: Both `use storescript;` and `use crossroads;` are strictly sandboxed at compile time. Neither profile can call `fs.*`, `reg.*`, `proc.*`, `ffi.*`, `net.*`, `msi.*`, `svc.*`, `com.*`, or `archive.*`—meaning community trainer scripts and interactive fiction modules are 100% safe to share, inspect, and execute offline without antivirus false positives or host filesystem risk.

---

## `storescript.*` — StoreScript Save-File & Config Trainer DSL (`20` Methods) {#storescript-namespace}

### Origin Story: Hello, StoreScript! {#storescript-origin}

Long before RaggieScript unified all eight RaggieSoft Studio developer tools, Michael P. Ragsdale envisioned **StoreScript** as a dedicated scripting language for **RaggieSoft StoreTrainer** (`storetrainer.raggiesoft.com`—originally created in the pre-AI Visual Basic 6.0 `TStore.vbp` era as an offline single-player PC game save-file and trainer utility).

In RaggieScript v1.3, **StoreScript is officially part of RaggieScript**:
- The host application (*StoreTrainer* on `.NET` via `RsscManagedRuntime.StoreScript` or C++20 via `RaggieScriptVm::LoadStoreScriptBuffer`) loads **only** the single save file or JSON configuration explicitly selected by the user into an isolated in-memory workspace.
- StoreScript provides automatic undo snapshots (`storescript.backupSave` / `restoreBackup`), wildcard hex-signature scanning (`"43 52 45 44 ?? ??"`), bounds-checked and min/max-clamped little-endian binary reads/writes (`U8`, `I16LE`, `I32LE`, `F32LE`, `Ascii`), IEEE 802.3 CRC-32 save-checksum recalculation (`crc32Range`), and dot-path JSON config editing (`getJson` / `setJson`).

### Complete `storescript.*` API Reference {#storescript-methods}

| Method | Signature | Return | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `storescript.profile` | `storescript.profile(id: string, title?: string, saveGlob?: string)` | `map` | Declares trainer metadata (`{ id, title, saveGlob }`) for StoreTrainer's library shelf. |
| `storescript.backupSave` | `storescript.backupSave(tag?: string)` | `string` | Captures an instant snapshot of the active save buffer and returns its `backupId`. |
| `storescript.restoreBackup` | `storescript.restoreBackup(backupId?: string)` | `bool` | Restores the active save buffer from `backupId` (or the most recent snapshot when omitted). |
| `storescript.size` | `storescript.size()` | `int` | Returns the byte length of the active binary save buffer. |
| `storescript.readU8` | `storescript.readU8(offset: int)` | `int` | Reads an unsigned 8-bit integer (`0..255`) at `offset` (bounds-checked). |
| `storescript.writeU8` | `storescript.writeU8(offset: int, value: int, min?: int, max?: int)` | `bool` | Clamps `value` to `[min, max]` (`0..255`) and writes 1 byte at `offset`. |
| `storescript.readI16LE` | `storescript.readI16LE(offset: int)` | `int` | Reads a signed 16-bit little-endian integer (`-32768..32767`) at `offset`. |
| `storescript.writeI16LE` | `storescript.writeI16LE(offset: int, value: int, min?: int, max?: int)` | `bool` | Clamps `value` and writes a 16-bit little-endian integer at `offset`. |
| `storescript.readI32LE` | `storescript.readI32LE(offset: int)` | `int` | Reads a signed 32-bit little-endian integer at `offset`. |
| `storescript.writeI32LE` | `storescript.writeI32LE(offset: int, value: int, min?: int, max?: int)` | `bool` | Clamps `value` to `[min, max]` and writes a 32-bit little-endian integer at `offset`. |
| `storescript.readU32LE` | `storescript.readU32LE(offset: int)` | `int` | Reads an unsigned 32-bit little-endian integer (`0..4294967295`) at `offset`. |
| `storescript.writeU32LE` | `storescript.writeU32LE(offset: int, value: int, min?: int, max?: int)` | `bool` | Clamps `value` (`0..4294967295`) and writes an unsigned 32-bit little-endian integer (ideal for CRC-32 checksums). |
| `storescript.readF32LE` | `storescript.readF32LE(offset: int)` | `float` | Reads a 32-bit IEEE 754 little-endian float at `offset`. |
| `storescript.writeF32LE` | `storescript.writeF32LE(offset: int, value: float, min?: float, max?: float)` | `bool` | Clamps `value` and writes a 32-bit IEEE 754 little-endian float at `offset`. |
| `storescript.readAscii` | `storescript.readAscii(offset: int, maxLen: int)` | `string` | Reads a null-padded fixed-width ASCII string of up to `maxLen` bytes at `offset`. |
| `storescript.writeAscii` | `storescript.writeAscii(offset: int, text: string, maxLen?: int)` | `bool` | Writes `text` at `offset` and zero-pads any remaining bytes up to `maxLen`. |
| `storescript.findPatternHex` | `storescript.findPatternHex(patternHex: string, startOffset?: int)` | `int` | Scans the save buffer for a hex byte signature supporting `??` wildcards (`"43 52 45 44 ?? ??"`); returns 0-based byte offset or `-1`. |
| `storescript.crc32Range` | `storescript.crc32Range(startOffset?: int, length?: int)` | `int` | Computes standard unsigned IEEE 802.3 CRC-32 over `[startOffset, startOffset + length)` so patched saves pass integrity checks! |
| `storescript.getJson` | `storescript.getJson(dotPath: string, fallback?: any)` | `any` | Reads a nested key (`"audio.subtitleScale"`) from the loaded JSON save/config document. |
| `storescript.setJson` | `storescript.setJson(dotPath: string, value: any)` | `bool` | Updates or creates a nested dot-path key inside the loaded JSON save/config document. |

```rssc
use storescript;

const meta = storescript.profile("cedar-run-tactics", "Cedar Run Tactics — Save Utility", "*.sav");

fn applyCreditsBoost(requestedCredits: int) : map {
    const snap = storescript.backupSave("pre-credits");
    const sigOffset = storescript.findPatternHex("43 52 45 44 ?? ??");
    if (sigOffset < 0) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "Signature not found" };
    }

    // Write clamped 32-bit little-endian credits right after the 6-byte header
    storescript.writeI32LE(sigOffset + 6, requestedCredits, min: 0, max: 999999);

    // Recompute IEEE CRC-32 over payload bytes [4..size) and store at offset 0
    const crc = storescript.crc32Range(4, storescript.size() - 4);
    storescript.writeU32LE(0, crc);
    return { ok: true, backupId: snap, newCredits: storescript.readI32LE(sigOffset + 6), crc32: crc };
}
```

---

## `crossroads.*` — RaggieSoft Story Crossroads Interactive Novel Engine (`8` Methods) {#crossroads-namespace}

**RaggieSoft Story Crossroads** (`crossroads.raggiesoft.com`, in-universe Architects: *Rowan & Iris Hawthorne*) is RaggieSoft's independent interactive-fiction imprint. A single `use crossroads;` `.rssc` file executes natively inside **RaggieSoft Book Reader** (`.NET`) and compiles via `raggiescript.exe transpile-es2022` (or `RsscEs2022Transpiler.TryTranspile`) into a zero-`eval()` ES2022 JavaScript module for the web!

| Method | Signature | Return | Targets | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `crossroads.visit` | `crossroads.visit(nodeId: string)` | `int` | C++20, `.NET`, `ES2022` | Marks narrative route node `nodeId` visited and returns the updated visit count (`1` on first visit). |
| `crossroads.visited` | `crossroads.visited(nodeId: string)` | `bool` | C++20, `.NET`, `ES2022` | Returns `true` if the reader has previously visited `nodeId`. |
| `crossroads.visitCount` | `crossroads.visitCount(nodeId: string)` | `int` | C++20, `.NET`, `ES2022` | Returns how many times the reader has visited `nodeId`. |
| `crossroads.setFlag` | `crossroads.setFlag(key: string, value?: any)` | `bool` | C++20, `.NET`, `ES2022` | Stores a persistent branching narrative flag (`value` defaults to `true`). |
| `crossroads.getFlag` | `crossroads.getFlag(key: string, fallback?: any)` | `any` | C++20, `.NET`, `ES2022` | Reads narrative flag `key` (or `fallback`, default `false`). |
| `crossroads.adjustStat` | `crossroads.adjustStat(statKey: string, delta: int, min?: int, max?: int)` | `int` | C++20, `.NET`, `ES2022` | Adds `delta` to `statKey`, clamps within `[min, max]`, and returns the updated value. |
| `crossroads.offerOption` | `crossroads.offerOption(label: string, targetNode: string, enabled?: bool, note?: string)` | `bool` | C++20, `.NET`, `ES2022` | Registers an interactive route option card (`{ label, target, enabled, note }`) for the current scene. |
| `crossroads.options` | `crossroads.options()` | `array` | C++20, `.NET`, `ES2022` | Returns all offered route option maps for the active Story Crossroads scene. |

```rssc
use crossroads;

fn evaluateKeystoneBridgeScene(hasLanternKey: bool) : array {
    const visits = crossroads.visit("cpi-keystone-bridge-dusk");
    if (hasLanternKey) {
        crossroads.setFlag("unlockedArchivistVault", true);
    }
    crossroads.offerOption(
        "Inspect the Ironstone keystone inscription with Iris",
        "cpi-pendleton-archive",
        true,
        visits > 1 ? "Revisit with new clues" : "First inspection"
    );
    crossroads.offerOption(
        "Unlock the lower Commonwealth Mall lantern passage",
        "cpi-lantern-vault",
        crossroads.getFlag("unlockedArchivistVault", false) == true,
        "Requires the Archivist's brass lantern key"
    );
    return crossroads.options();
}
```


================================================================================
TOPIC: Diagnostics Reference (RSW700 – RSW715) [diagnostics-reference] (Diagnostics & Bytecode ISA)
================================================================================

# Compiler & Verifier Diagnostics Reference (`RSW700` – `RSW715`) {#diagnostics-reference}

Every diagnostic emitted by `raggiescript.exe check`, `raggiescript.exe lsp`, `instbuild.exe`, and `RaggieScript.Core` carries a stable `RSW7xx` code, 1-based `(line, column)` coordinates, and actionable fix guidance.

## Summary Table of All RaggieScript Diagnostics {#diagnostics-table}

| Code | Category | Phase | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `RSW700` | Lexical / Syntax / Preprocessor | Parse | Unterminated string/comment, unexpected token, missing `;` / `}`, or cyclic `include`. |
| `RSW701` | **Wizard Phase Isolation** | Binder | Mutating call (`fs.write*`, `reg.write*`, `msi.install`, `svc.*`, etc.) reached directly or transitively inside `wizard { ... }`. |
| `RSW702` | **Capability Sandbox Violation** | Binder | Sandboxed Studio profile (`use training;`, `use a11y;`, `use localization;`, `use document;`) attempted host OS/FS/Registry/Network access. |
| `RSW704` | **Bytecode & SHA-256 Integrity** | Loader | Invalid `RSWBC2`/`RSWBC1` magic header, truncated stream, or 32-byte SHA-256 tamper mismatch! |
| `RSW710` | **Undeclared Identifier** | Type Binder | Variable, `ref` target, or function name is not in scope (includes Levenshtein `"Did you mean '...'?"` hint). |
| `RSW711` | **Static Type Mismatch** | Type Binder | Incompatible initializer, assignment, `struct` field type, `match` arm pattern, or `return` value type. |
| `RSW712` | **Call Arity or Unknown Method** | Type Binder | Unknown `ns.method()` (with fuzzy suggestion) or wrong argument count/type passed to a function. |
| `RSW713` | **Immutability Violation** | Type Binder / VM | Reassigning a `const` binding, passing a `const` variable as `ref`, or mutating a CLI hard-locked `KEY:VALUE` parameter. |
| `RSW714` | **Unknown `struct` Field or `enum` Variant** | Type Binder | Typo in `MyStruct { badField: 1 }` or `MyEnum.BadVariant` (includes fuzzy field/variant suggestion). |
| `RSW715` | **Control-Flow Violation** | Type Binder | Non-`void` typed `fn` missing a `return` along a code path, or `break;` / `continue;` outside a loop. |

---

## Detailed Diagnostic Guides & Fixes {#diagnostic-examples}

### `RSW701` — Wizard Phase Isolation Violation {#rsw701}
**Why it happens**: `wizard { ... }` (and any helper `fn` called from `wizard`) must remain 100% read-only so canceling the wizard leaves zero trace on the PC and `Uac.Deferred` can run the wizard un-elevated.

```rssc
// FAILS WITH RSW701:
wizard {
    step Welcome {
        reg.writeString(Hive.HKCU, r"Software\App", "VisitedWizard", "1"); // <-- RSW701!
    }
}

// FIX: Bind a 'param' in wizard, and write to the Registry inside 'install { ... }'!
param optedIn: bool = true;
wizard {
    step Welcome { ui.checkbox(text: "Save preference", bind: ref optedIn); }
}
install {
    if (optedIn) { reg.writeString(Hive.HKCU, r"Software\App", "OptedIn", "1"); }
}
```

### `RSW702` — Capability Sandbox Violation {#rsw702}
**Why it happens**: Scripts running inside SCORM web courses (`use training;`) or compliance linters (`use a11y;`) are isolated from host OS I/O. Remove `fs.*`/`reg.*`/`net.*` calls or switch to `use installer;` for native setup tools.

### `RSW704` — Bytecode SHA-256 Tamper Rejection {#rsw704}
**Why it happens**: Every compiled `.rswbc` file and `#225` PE resource embeds a 32-byte `bcrypt.dll` SHA-256 digest over the entire constant pool and instruction stream. Any single flipped bit halts `LoadRaggieScriptBytecode` before a single instruction executes.

### `RSW710` & `RSW714` — Undeclared Symbol / Unknown Field (Fuzzy Suggestions) {#rsw710-rsw714}
```rssc
param installDir: path = sys.programFiles / "Demo";
install {
    fs.mkdir(instalDir);
    // -> [RSW710] Undeclared identifier 'instalDir'. Did you mean 'installDir'?
}
```

### `RSW711`, `RSW712`, `RSW713` & `RSW715` — Type, Arity, `const` & Return Checks {#rsw711-rsw715}
```rssc
const lockedPort: int = 8443;
// ui.textBox(label: "Port:", bind: ref lockedPort);
// -> [RSW713] Cannot pass immutable 'const' binding 'lockedPort' by 'ref'. Use 'param' or 'let'!

fn computePort(useTls: bool) : int {
    if (useTls) { return 443; }
    // -> [RSW715] Function 'computePort()' declares return type 'int' but not all control paths return a value.
    return 8080;
}
```


================================================================================
TOPIC: RSWBC2 Bytecode ISA & .rsw-rollback.jnl Spec [bytecode-and-rollback] (Diagnostics & Bytecode ISA)
================================================================================

# `RSWBC2` Linear Stack Bytecode ISA & `.rsw-rollback.jnl` Specification {#bytecode-and-rollback}

This reference documents the binary layout of RaggieScript's **`RSWBC2`** bytecode container (`RsscBytecodeIsa.hpp`) and the on-disk transactional rollback journal (`RaggieScriptSdk.hpp`).

## `RSWBC2` Binary Container Header (`48` Bytes + Sections) {#rswbc2-header}

| Offset | Size | Field | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `0x00` | `6` bytes | `Magic` | ASCII `"RSWBC2"` (`RaggieScriptVm` also loads `"RSWBC1"` transparently). |
| `0x06` | `2` bytes | `IsaVersion` | Little-endian `uint16` (`0x0100` = ISA v1.0). |
| `0x08` | `4` bytes | `Flags` | Bit `0`: `RSW701` Wizard Verified; Bit `1`: `RSW702` Sandboxed Profile. |
| `0x0C` | `4` bytes | `PayloadLength` | Byte length of the serialized metadata + constant pool + chunk table. |
| `0x10` | `32` bytes | `Sha256Digest` | `bcrypt.dll` SHA-256 digest over all `PayloadLength` bytes (`RSW704` verified before load!). |
| `0x30` | `PayloadLength` | `Sections` | Package header metadata, `struct`/`enum`/`param`/`feature`/`payload` descriptors, deduplicated Constant Pool, and Linear Instruction Chunks. |

## Linear Stack VM Instruction Set (`OpCode`) {#opcode-isa}

Each instruction is a fixed compact tuple `(op: uint8, a: uint32, b: int32, srcLine: uint32)`:

| Opcode | Operands | Stack Effect | Semantics |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `NOP` | — | `0` | No operation. |
| `PUSH_NULL` | — | `+1` | Pushes `null`. |
| `PUSH_BOOL` | `b` (`0`/`1`) | `+1` | Pushes `false` or `true`. |
| `PUSH_INT` | `a` (const idx) | `+1` | Pushes 64-bit `int` from constant pool. |
| `PUSH_FLOAT` | `a` (const idx) | `+1` | Pushes 64-bit `float` from constant pool. |
| `PUSH_STR` | `a` (const idx) | `+1` | Pushes UTF-8 `string` from constant pool. |
| `PUSH_VER` | `a` (const idx) | `+1` | Pushes 4-part `SemVer` `version`. |
| `POP` | — | `-1` | Discards top of stack. |
| `LOAD_VAR` | `a` (name idx) | `+1` | Resolves lexical local -> closure upvalue -> global variable. |
| `DECL_VAR` | `a` (name), `b` (`isConst`) | `-1` | Declares variable in current lexical frame with popped initializer. |
| `STORE_VAR` | `a` (name), `b` (assign op) | `0` (`-1` + push) | Mutates existing mutable binding (enforcing `RSW713` CLI hard-locks!). |
| `MAKE_REF` | `a` (name idx) | `+1` | Pushes two-way mutable `RefVar` handle for Wizard `bind:` / `TaskDialog` slots. |
| `MAKE_ARRAY` | `a` (`count`) | `-(count) + 1` | Pops `count` elements into a new `array`. |
| `MAKE_MAP` | `a` (`pairCount`) | `-(2*pairCount) + 1` | Pops `(key, val)` pairs into a `map`. |
| `MAKE_STRUCT` | `a` (struct idx), `b` (`pairCount`) | `-(2*pairCount) + 1` | Hydrates `struct` defaults and applies explicit field initializers. |
| `MAKE_CLOSURE` | `a` (chunk idx) | `+1` | Captures lexical environment into a first-class callable closure value. |
| `GET_MEMBER` / `SET_MEMBER` | `a` (prop idx) | `0` / `-1` | Reads or writes `map`/`struct`/enum/namespace property. |
| `GET_INDEX` / `SET_INDEX` | — | `-1` / `-2` | Reads or writes `arr[idx]` / `map[key]`. |
| `UNARY_OP` / `BINARY_OP` | `b` (op code) | `0` / `-1` | Executes `!`, `-`, `+`, `/`, `==`, `<`, `SemVer` compare, etc. |
| `JUMP` / `JUMP_IF_FALSE` / `JUMP_IF_TRUE` / `JUMP_IF_NOT_NULL` | `a` (target IP) | `0` / `-1` | Structured control-flow, short-circuit `&&`/`\|\|`, `??`, and `match` arms. |
| `CALL_HOST` | `a` (`ns.method`), `b` (`argc`) | `-(2*argc) + 1` | Pops named/positional `(argName, argVal)` pairs and invokes the 21-namespace C++20 Stdlib. |
| `CALL_VALUE` | `b` (`argc`) | `-(2*argc)` | Invokes user `fn`, global builtin, or first-class closure value! |
| `WIZ_STEP_BEGIN` / `WIZ_STEP_END` | `a` (step name) | `0` | Registers declarative Wizard step boundaries with `RsscWizardUiEngine`. |
| `DEFER_PUSH` | `a` (defer chunk idx) | `0` | Pushes a lexical cleanup closure onto the current frame's LIFO `defer` stack (executed on `RET` or `THROW`). |
| `RETURN` / `EXIT_SETUP` / `THROW` | — | `-1` | Runs frame `defer` stack in LIFO order, then returns from chunk, exits setup, or raises catchable exception. |

> [!TIP] Inspect the exact bytecode generated for any `.rssc` script at any time by running `raggiescript.exe disasm my-setup.rssc`!

## Transactional Rollback Ledger (`.rsw-rollback.jnl`) {#rollback-journal}

Before the first mutating operation inside `install { ... }`, `RaggieScriptVm` opens `<installDir>\.rsw-rollback.jnl` (with automatic fallback to `%TEMP%` before `<installDir>` exists) and flushes each pre-image record to disk **before** performing the OS mutation:

1. **New File / Extracted Payload (`FILE_CREATED`)**: Records path; deleted on rollback.
2. **Overwritten File / `.ini` / `.xml` / `.json` (`FILE_OVERWRITTEN`)**: Copies original bytes to `<file>.<seq>.rswbak`; restored atomically over `<file>` on rollback, or deleted cleanly upon commit!
3. **Created Directory (`DIR_CREATED`)**: Recorded in creation order; removed in reverse leaf-first LIFO order if empty on rollback.
4. **Registry Value (`REG_CREATED` / `REG_OVERWRITTEN`)**: Captures prior `REG_SZ`/`REG_EXPAND_SZ`/`REG_DWORD`/`REG_MULTI_SZ` type and bytes + `RegView` (`64` vs `32`); restores exact prior type/bytes or deletes newly added values on rollback.
5. **Services, Shortcuts, Firewall Rules & `PATH` Entries**: Journals exact inverse removal/restoration commands—and reuses the exact same journal model inside `<InstallDir>\Uninstall.rswm` so `Uninstall.exe` leaves zero orphan keys or `PATH` cruft!
